The Complimentary 4th Night hotel benefit is only available with properties listed on Citi Travel via \u003ca href=”http://www.cititravel.com/”\u003ecititravel.com\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/br\u003e\n\u003cbr\u003eCardmembers are eligible for no more than two Complimentary 4th Night hotel benefits per Citi Prestige card account per calendar year. Prices, Additional Charges, Taxes and Fees, Agoda exchange rates\u003c/h5\u003e\n    \u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003e\u003ch6\u003eA. Prices \u003c/h6\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003e We strive to have the most competitive prices and we want you to pay the lowest fare possible for your flight. Sometimes cheaper fares are available on the Site for a Flight, for the same flight sector/s on the same date, at the same time and on the same airline, however, these cheaper fares may carry special restrictions and conditions, for example in respect of cancellation and refund. Please check the fare and rate details thoroughly for any such conditions prior to making your reservation. The same flight sector/s may have different rates, depending on such restrictions and conditions (see also section 6 below).\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003e\u003ch7\u003eB. Additional Charges\u003c/h7\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003ePlease note that all prices on the Site are for your Flight reservation only and are for the\n        requested flights and for the number of people indicated, unless indicated otherwise. The Flight\n        reservations rates are displayed per person. Except where indicated otherwise, Agoda will typically display\n        the rate exclusive of tax and service charges (see below for more details) on the Site and display these\n        additional tax amounts and service charges during the booking path. Without prejudice to what is set out\n        below, you will see the total inclusive price prior to confirming your booking and after you have provided details of your method of payment. Where the actual credit card fee charged by your credit card issuer can only be confirmed by your credit card issuer once payment has been made, the total inclusive price during the booking path and on the final booking page will display the maximum credit card fee as advised by our suppliers.  The actual credit card fee will be stated in your confirmation email and can be lower than the stated maximum credit card fee. Credit card fees are determined and calculated by our suppliers or your credit card issuer and not by us and we have no control over these fees. Display settings may vary,\n        but this will at the latest show on the final booking page (before the confirmation screen). Please verify\n        every step of your reservation on the booking form; you can discontinue the booking at any time prior to the\n        final confirmation screen (please see below for post-booking cancellations). What is included in the fare is\n        displayed on the Site (under the Flight information section or prior to the final booking confirmation)\n        and/or in the confirmation email. Please verify the Flight description or policies on the Site.  We may also charge a booking fee for certain types of bookings.  This will be displayed in the booking form and confirmation screen as an Agoda Booking Fee.  This booking fee may also be charged separately to the Flight reservation, taxes and charges, depending on your Payment Instrument.  This Agoda Booking Fee would be in the Display Currency and converted into the Payment Currency (see below for more details). Insurance of\n        any kind is never included in the rates. You may also be charged directly by the airline for fuel and insurance surcharges, baggage handling fees, seat allocation, meals, priority boarding, or in-flight\n        entertainment fees. The practice of airlines to add additional Flight fees is outside Agoda\u0026rsquo;s control.\n        Needless to say, optional incidental fees and personal consumption expenses and charges are not included in\n        most fare types Please check the airline website, \u0026ldquo;Flight Information\u0026rdquo;, \u0026ldquo;Booking\n        Conditions\u0026rdquo;, \u0026ldquo;Cancellation Policy\u0026rdquo; or similar wording on the Site. When in doubt whether\n        something is included, you can contact our Customer Service team.\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003ePlease note that Agoda does not organize any ground transportation, this is always organized\n        by and offered by or on behalf of the airline or one of our partners, who are responsible for such\n        transportation services, not Agoda. Agoda does not assume any liability for the quality, safety, frequency\n        or service levels of such transportation services. Please verify with \u003cu\u003eCustomer\n            Service\u003c/u\u003e\u0026nbsp;which extra fees are (not) included.\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003e\u003ch8\u003eC. Additional Charges for Ancillary Services\u003c/h8\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003ePlease note that all prices on the Site are for Ancillary Services are set by our Partners,\n        unless otherwise indicated. Please refer to the appropriate Partner\u0026rsquo;s terms and conditions for any\n        additional charges that may be applicable to your reservation (for example: airport tax).\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003e\u003ch9\u003eD. Currency Conversion\u003c/h9\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003eYou may view the fares for the Flights in the following currencies:\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003e\u0026middot; \u003cstrong\u003eDisplay Currency\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026nbsp;means the currency in which you\n        choose to view prices on our Site.\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003e\u0026middot; \u003cstrong\u003ePayment Currency\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026nbsp;means the currency in which you\n        choose to pay for a booking.\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eAccount provider rates\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003eIf your Payment Currency is different from the currency of your credit card or bank account and/or the currency in which the fare, taxes and charges are quoted, your bank, card issuer, our suppliers or the airline will determine the exchange rate to use when the transaction is applied to your account. Your\n        account provider may offer a higher or lower rate than Agoda, and may charge you additional fees for a\n        foreign currency transaction. Agoda does not control or benefit from your account provider\u0026rsquo;s exchange rate or\n        fees charged by your bank, card issuer or the airline.\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eAgoda rates\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003eIf your Payment Currency is the same as the currency of your credit card or bank account, but different from your\n        Display Currency, Agoda will use our Indicated Rate or Daily Adjusted Rate or the rate provided by the airline, your bank, our suppliers or card issuer to convert prices. The applicable\n        rate will depend on choices you select when viewing listings and making a booking. The Indicated Rate or Daily Adjusted Rate are, as described below.\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cul type=\u0022disc\u0022\u003e\n        \u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eIndicated Rate\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026nbsp;\u0026ndash; Bloomberg Generic\n            Composite Rate mid-rate on the current day.\u003c/li\u003e\n        \u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eDaily Adjusted Rate\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026nbsp;\u0026ndash; Bloomberg\n            Generic Composite Rate on the day payment is processed plus 5%.\u003c/li\u003e\n    \u003c/ul\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003eWhen you choose to have Agoda handle the currency conversion on the transaction, we will not\n        charge you an additional transaction or service fee.\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eConverted currency prices are indicative\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003eIf you choose a fare which is priced in a currency that is different from your Display Currency, Agoda will\n        display indicative prices converted using our Indicated Rate. The converted Display Currency price is a\n        preliminary estimate of the price in your Display Currency and is not firm or binding. The converted price\n        in the Display Currency is provided for your convenience, to allow you to compare different fares and\n        conditions in the currency you prefer to use.\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003ePay Now bookings\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003eWhen you select your Payment Currency on the booking page, we will update your total price to\n        show the amount we will process to your payment account. We can do this because we know the exchange rate at\n        that time. If you choose a Payment Currency that is different from the Display Currency, Agoda will use the\n        Daily Adjusted Rate to convert the amount. For all other Pay Now transactions, we will use our Indicated\n        Rate to convert currencies.\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eA Word on Charges for Taxes and Fees\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003eIn connection with facilitating your Flight transaction, the charge to your Payment Instrument\n        may include an amount for charges, taxes and fees (\u0026ldquo;Taxes and Fees\u0026rdquo;) unless indicated otherwise.\n        In relation to Flights, this charge includes an estimated amount to recover the amount Agoda Companies pay\n        on your behalf to the airlines in connection with your reservation for taxes owed by the airlines, in respect of\n        their service to you, including, without limitation, departure, airport use, terminal, aviation security,\n        aviation insurance and fuel surcharges and taxes, sales tax, excise tax, value added tax and/or other\n        similar taxes. In certain locations, the tax amount may also include government imposed service fees or\n        other fees not paid directly to the taxing authorities but required by law to be collected by the airlines.\n        The amount paid to the airlines on your behalf in connection with your flight sector/s for taxes may vary from\n        the amount Agoda Companies estimate and include in the charge to you. The balance of the charge for Taxes\n        and Fees, if any, is a fee Agoda Companies retain as part of the compensation for our facilitation services\n        and to cover the costs of facilitating your reservation, including, for example, customer service costs. If\n        the balance is negative, Agoda Companies will absorb such difference. The charge for Taxes and Fees varies\n        based on a number of factors including, without limitation, the amount Agoda Companies pay the airlines on\n        your behalf and the destination and duration of the Flight and may include profit that Agoda Companies\n        retain.\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003eExcept as described below, Agoda Companies are not the vendors collecting and remitting taxes\n        to the applicable taxing authorities. The Flight suppliers, as vendors, include all applicable taxes in the\n        amount billed and Agoda Companies pay over such amounts on your behalf directly to the vendors. Agoda\n        Companies are not co-vendors associated with the vendors with whom we book or reserve our customer\u0027s travel\n        arrangements. Taxability and the appropriate tax rate and the type of applicable taxes vary greatly by\n        location.\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003eFor transactions involving Flight suppliers located within certain jurisdictions, the charge to your\n        Payment Instrument for Taxes and Fees includes a payment of tax that Agoda Companies are required to collect\n        and remit to the jurisdiction for tax owed on amounts Agoda Companies retain as compensation for their\n        facilitation services.\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003eIn relation to Ancillary Services, calculation of applicable taxes and fees will be set out in our or \n        our Partner\u0026rsquo;s terms and conditions.\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003e\u003ch10\u003e4. Privacy\u003c/h10\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003eWe respect your privacy. Please have a look at our\u0026nbsp;\u003cu\u003ePrivacy\n            Policy\u003c/u\u003e\u0026nbsp;for further information.\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003e\u003ch11\u003e5. Payment - Credit Card \u0026ndash;\u0026ndash; Age - Fraud\u003c/h11\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003eFor pre-paid Flight bookings through Agoda as your facilitator, you authorize us to collect\n        and process (including the collection and processing through a third party) your information required by\n        processing service providers or the financial institution that issues your Payment Instrument such as a\n        credit or debit card in order to verify your identity. Personal information collected about you and that may\n        be shared to such third parties (including to handle your transaction and/or maintain your account) is set\n        out in our \u003ca href=\u0022/info/agoda-privacy.html\u0022\u003ePrivacy Policy\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003eTo complete payment for such pre-paid Flight bookings, you authorize the applicable Agoda\n        Companies to charge or debit your Payment Instrument for the full price, sometimes without any option for\n        refund depending on the Flight\u0026rsquo;s booking conditions, see below, upon reservation and confirmation of\n        the booking. If the Payment Instrument cannot be charged on the date of payment for whatever reason, the\n        booking will be cancelled unless you can ensure that the card payment can be authorized on time. Please\n        check the reservation details thoroughly for any such conditions prior to making your reservation. Agoda\n        Companies will process refunds, if and when applicable, within a reasonable timeframe. You also authorize\n        the crediting to your Payment Instrument in case of reversals, refunds, or adjustments through the service\n        which facilitates the processing of payment transactions. In order to safeguard and encrypt your Payment\n        Instrument information when in transit to us, we use the \u0022\u003cstrong\u003eSecure Socket Layer (SSL)\u003c/strong\u003e\u0022\n        technology for our services. Please note that your bank may impose additional fees on the transaction, over\n        which Agoda Companies have no control.\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003eCertain Payment Instrument companies charge their member banks a fee for processing\n        \u0022\u003cstrong\u003eforeign transactions\u003c/strong\u003e\u0022. If you make card transactions and the recipient uses a bank located\n        in a different country other than the bank which issued your card, an international service assessment,\n        cross-border transaction fee or similar fee may be charged. Your issuing bank may or may not pass this fee\n        on to you, the card user. Please contact your issuing bank for details as this is outside the control of\n        Agoda Companies.\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003eIn the event of Payment Instrument fraud or unauthorized use of your Payment Instrument by\n        third parties, you should contact your bank or card issuer immediately upon becoming aware of such\n        unauthorized use. If you suspect an unauthorized or fraudulent booking was made via Agoda, please contact\n        our Customer Service team immediately.\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003eIn order to make a booking you must be over 18 years old (or such other age at which majority\n        is reached in your country or territory) and have the full legal capacity to make the transaction (or have\n        the authorization to do so from your legal guardian). You undertake that the credit or debit card you are\n        using is your own or that you are authorized to complete the booking with this card and that there are\n        sufficient funds to cover the cost of the transaction. You accept financial responsibility for all\n        transactions made under your name or account.\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003eYou undertake that the details you provide us with in making a booking are fully correct.\n        Agoda Companies reserve the right not to accept certain Payment Instruments. Agoda may add or remove other\n        payment methods at its discretion. For increased convenience, Agoda now also offers the option to have your\n        Payment Instrument details securely stored on file. For more details, have a look at our Privacy\n        Policy.\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003eWe have stringent fraud detection and prevention mechanisms in place. In certain cases, we may\n        require additional information or verifications to validate and confirm the booking, as explained in more\n        detail on the Site. Reservations are not confirmed until you have received a confirmation email and it is\n        possible that a Flight could become fully booked during the fraud check, in which case the reservation will\n        no longer be available. Agoda can never be held liable in such cases. Additional information submitted will\n        be treated in line with strict industry standards to protect privacy, using encryption for transmission and\n        specialized agents for verification. If you choose not to submit the additional information or if we are not\n        satisfied with the information received, the booking will not be completed and fully cancelled and any\n        amounts charged (including the verification charge where applicable) will be refunded.\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eA word about failed payments\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003e For a variety of reasons, payment on the Site may fail. In such cases, a new booking should be made. If you have any questions, please contact our Customer Service department.\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003eWe reserve the right to cancel your booking if full payment is not received in a timely fashion.\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003e\u003ch12\u003e6. Booking conditions - Cancellations, No-Shows, Refunds\u0026ndash; Specific Flight\n            Policies - Special Needs \u0026ndash; additional Agoda services or products\u003c/h12\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003eBy making a Flight reservation on our Site, you accept and agree to the relevant Flight\n        booking conditions, including refund, cancellation and no-show policies applicable to that booking, and to\n        any additional terms and conditions of the Flight that may apply to your flight sector/s. The terms and\n        conditions of carriage for a Flight can be obtained from the airline. The general cancellation and no-show\n        policy of each Flight is available on the airline website and made available on the Site at the Flight\n        information pages or under \u0026ldquo;Booking Conditions\u0026rdquo;, \u0026ldquo;Cancellation Policies\u0026rdquo; or the\n        like, and in the confirmation email. Please note that you may be charged for your cancellation in accordance\n        with the Flight\u0026rsquo;s cancellation and no-show policies. We recommend that you read the refund,\n        cancellation and no-show policies of the Flight carefully prior to making your reservation. If you fail to\n        check in for your Flight or do not travel on a flight for which you have received a boarding pass, the\n        remaining flight sector/s may be cancelled and you may not be entitled to a refund, depending on the terms\n        and conditions of the applicable Flight. Regardless of the Flight\u0026rsquo;s cancellation policy, Agoda\n        Companies reserve the right to charge a cancellation fee and this will be indicated on the Site. Please\n        carefully check the Flight details thoroughly for any such conditions prior to making your reservation.\n    \u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003eIf you wish to review, adjust or cancel your reservation, please revert to the confirmation\n        email and follow the instructions therein, use our self-service tool or contact Customer Service. There will\n        be an additional charge or fee of up to USD 10 per passenger for changing your reservation and this would be in addition to any charges by\n        the airline to change your booking. The additional charges or fees will be applicable at the time you make changes to or cancel your reservation.\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003eMany airlines have specific policies around children, accompanying travelers and/or traveling\n        with pets. As indicated above, you are strongly advised to check with Customer Service, the airline itself or\n        to verify the Flight policies.\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003eSpecial Needs: If you have special needs, such as requiring a wheelchair, you must contact\n        Customer Service or the airline and verify that special needs can be met. Special needs are the\n        responsibility of the airline and not of Agoda. Please note that all special requests are subject to\n        availability and cannot be guaranteed by Agoda. Depending on the policy of the applicable Flight, your\n        reservation will be refunded, cancelled or modified if special needs cannot be met. If available, your\n        request will be confirmed upon arrival.\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eA word about Agoda Price Alerts\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003cp\u003eYou may elect to set Agoda \u0026ldquo;Price Alerts\u0026rdquo; for Flights found on our Site, where\n        available. If selected, we will send you a Price Alert when prices for your selected Flight(s) and for the\n        indicated time frame on our Site change. Sending a Price Alert will only be triggered if the Flight price\n        changes beyond a \u0022materiality\u0022 threshold we set. The type of Price Alert sent to you will depend on the\n        medium you use, that is by email if your chosen Site is the Agoda website or by push notification if your\n        chosen Site is our Agoda app. You are responsible for updating your Price Alert settings. In case We are unable to find a reasonable alternative Flight(s), we may agree with You on Our proportional contribution to the costs associated with the mutually agreed alternative transportation. Please note that You are always obliged to contact Us and obtain Our confirmation before purchasing ticket(s) for the alternate transportation on Your own, otherwise You will not be entitled to the refund of its price hereunder. Please note that any extra services or upgrades to the agreed upon alternative ticket(s) will not be covered by Us.\u003c/p\u003e \u003cp\u003eYou are obliged to reply to Us of Your decision promptly after receiving information of the offered solution from Us, but in all cases, within 24 hours commencing from the time of the scheduled departure of the first Flight of Your itinerary. AGODA SERVICES\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e6.1 The terms in this Section B apply to Agoda\u0026rsquo;s provision of its Travel Product booking facilitation-related Services through the Platform. Where the Travel Product booking facilitation-related Services are provided by any Partner or made via a Partner\u0026rsquo;s platform, please refer to that Partner\u0026rsquo;s respective terms and conditions of use and privacy policy instead as these will govern the relationship between you and that Partner. For the avoidance of doubt, where the Travel Product is provided by a Partner, your booking through the Platform is an offer to book a reservation (e.g., for Accommodations, Flights or a rental car, you are making a request to book a reservation with the Partner that is subject to acceptance by the Partner before it becomes a binding transaction) at the price listed on the Platform for such Travel Product on such other terms and conditions notified to you by the Partner at the time of booking, which shall become a binding contract when your booking is accepted by the Partner and will be subject to the Partner\u0026rsquo;s terms and conditions. The Partner reserves the right to reject bookings as set out in their terms and conditions.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e6.2 Unless otherwise stated, all of our Travel Product booking facilitation-related Services are provided by Agoda Company Pte. Ltd., which is a private limited liability company, incorporated under the laws of Singapore, having its registered address at 36 Robinson Road, #20-01 City House, Singapore 068877 and is registered with the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority of Singapore under company registration number 200506877R.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e6.3 Please note that Agoda does not organize any ground transportation. Agoda does not assume any liability for the quality, safety, frequency, or service levels of such transportation services. BOOKINGS\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e7.1 When making a booking for any Travel Product through our Platform, that booking is made directly with the Travel Supplier(s) named on the booking page. Our Platform only acts as a facilitator of such bookings. We do not provide, own or control any of the Travel Products that you can access through our Platform and we have no obligation to provide or operate the Travel Products. The Travel Products are owned, controlled or made available by the Travel Suppliers either directly or as an agent. The Travel Suppliers are responsible for their respective Travel Products. Your interaction with any Travel Supplier through our Platform is at your own risk. Agoda does not bear any responsibility should anything go wrong during your travel or your use of the Travel Product.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e7.2 A credit card, debit card, digital wallet or such other payment method as we may from time to time accept (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003ePayment Instrument\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;) will be required in order to make a booking for a Travel Product through our Platform.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e7.3 When you submit a booking through our Platform, you make an offer to book the specified Travel Product(s) subject to these Terms (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eBooking Request\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;). The Travel Product shall be supplied by the Travel Supplier to you and the terms and conditions applicable to that Travel Product shall be between you and the Travel Supplier and shall be a separate binding contract pursuant to these Terms between you and the relevant Travel Supplier once accepted by such Travel Supplier, communicated to Agoda, and subsequently communicated to you via a confirmation email from Agoda (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eConfirmed Booking\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;). You acknowledge that the \u0026ldquo;thank you page\u0026rdquo; shown after the submission of your Booking Request does not indicate a Confirmed Booking and only indicates that your Booking Request has been received by Agoda for processing.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e7.4 In some cases, we may provide you with a confirmation number in the confirmation email (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eBooking Confirmation Number\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;). Depending on the policy of the Travel Supplier, the confirmation may also contain a voucher for redemption (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eBooking Voucher\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;). Neither we nor the Travel Supplier will be responsible for Booking Confirmation Numbers or Booking Vouchers that are lost, stolen, mutilated, damaged or destroyed.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e7.5 The relevant Travel Supplier(s) may impose additional terms and conditions, rules and restrictions (each a \u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eTravel Supplier Terms\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;) that will be applicable to your Confirmed Booking, including in relation to changes, cancellations and refunds. You will be provided with the name of each Travel Supplier and in some cases, the applicable Travel Supplier Terms or a link to their Travel Supplier Terms, during the booking process. As the Travel Supplier Terms applicable for each Travel Product may vary, you should ensure that you fully understand and accept all of the applicable Travel Supplier Terms before completing your booking. If you are booking on behalf of other persons, you are required to ensure that they are aware of and agree to the applicable Travel Supplier Terms. If you fail to comply with the Travel Supplier Terms, the Travel Supplier has a right to refuse or cancel your booking without offering any refunds. For enquiries about the Travel Supplier’s products and services or its Travel Supplier Terms, please contact the Travel Supplier directly.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e7.6\tAgoda has the right to reject any Booking Request, and cancel any Confirmed Booking, including on behalf of the Travel Supplier, or any part thereof, for one or more of the following reasons:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;7.6.1\tyou are in breach of these Terms, Travel Supplier Terms, or any applicable law;\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;7.6.2\tAgoda reserves the right to reject any Booking Request on the basis of actual or suspected fraud and to cancel any Confirmed Booking on the basis of actual or suspected fraud or abuse;\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;7.6.3\tany event or circumstance set forth in clause 38.1;\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;7.6.4\tregular or emergency maintenance of Agoda’s Platform and systems is required;\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;7.6.5\tthe Travel Supplier rejects or cancels the Booking Request (including cases where bookings are not accepted from individuals holding certain passports or using payment methods issued by specific financial institutions);\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;7.6.6\tthe Travel Supplier is unable to provide the product or service due to technical issues in the systems necessary to complete the Customer’s booking; or\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;7.6.7\tthere is an error in the information entered by the Customer at the time of booking, and the Customer fails to correct it despite notification from Agoda.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIf you have already made payment, we shall refund you the amounts paid in respect of such rejected or cancelled parts in accordance with the applicable refund policy for your Booking.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp class=\u0022fontsmallb\u0022\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e8. PRICING, ADDITIONAL CHARGES AND TAXES\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ca name=\u002212\u0022\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e8.1 Currency selection and effects\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThe price you pay for a booking will depend on your selected payment methods (may include, \u0026ldquo;Pay Now\u0026rdquo;, \u0026ldquo;Book Now, Pay Later\u0026rdquo;, \u0026ldquo;Pay at Hotel\u0026rdquo; or \u0026ldquo;Book with Zero Pay\u0026rdquo;, as described in clauses 9 and 15, Display Currency, Payment Instrument, Payment Instrument Currency, Product Currency, Charge Currency, and any applicable credits and discounts, among other things.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;a. \u0026ldquo;\u003cb\u003eDisplay Currency\u003c/b\u003e\u0026rdquo; means the currency displayed to you on the Platform. Your default Display Currency is based on your IP address and/or your Account Settings.\u003c/p\u003e \n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;You can select your preferred Display Currency by clicking the currency code (e.g. USD, AUD) shown on the Platform, or in Account Settings.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;b. \u0026ldquo;\u003cb\u003ePayment Instrument Currency\u003c/b\u003e\u0026rdquo; means the default currency of the Payment Instrument as determined by the issuer of the Payment Instrument.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;c. \u0026ldquo;\u003cb\u003eProduct Currency\u003c/b\u003e\u0026rdquo; means the currency of the Travel Product based on the location of the Travel Product or the currency that the Travel Supplier uses for its Travel Product listings with Agoda.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;d. \u0026ldquo;\u003cb\u003eCharge Currency\u003c/b\u003e\u0026rdquo; means the currency in which you are charged for a booking.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThe Platform allows users across the globe to make bookings with Travel Suppliers around the world. Hence, the Platform provides you with the ability to choose the Display Currency and/or the Charge Currency.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eBefore you select your Charge Currency on the booking form/payment information page, the Platform shows you estimated prices of your booking in your Display Currency for your convenient reference only. Where relevant, Agoda uses the Bloomberg Generic Composite Rate to calculate those estimated prices of your booking.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eOn the payment information page, when your Payment Instrument Currency is different from the Display Currency, Agoda may propose you, as Charge Currency, to be charged in Display Currency or Payment Instrument Currency.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ctable style=\u0022border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; border-spacing: 20px;\u0022\u003e\n  \u003ctr\u003e\n    \u003ctd style=\u0022width:30%; padding-top: 20px; padding-bottom: 20px;\u0022\u003eIf you select a \u003cstrong\u003e“Pay Now” booking …\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\n    \u003ctd style=\u0022padding-top: 20px; padding-bottom: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd;\u0022\u003e\n      Agoda will calculate the price for your booking using the Bloomberg Generic Composite Rate. However, after you select your Charge Currency, an additional amount up to 5% of the price (the \u0026ldquo;\u003cb\u003eAdditional Amount\u0026rdquo;\u003c/b\u003e) will be added when Charge Currency is different from Display Currency, except when \u003ci\u003e(A) you are paying with a US-issuer Payment Instrument whose Payment Instrument Currency is USD; and/or (B) you are booking from an IP address located in the United States (US), Canada, or the United Kingdom; and/or (C) you are paying with an India-issuer Payment Instrument and making booking for Accommodations in India.\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\t  \u003cp\u003eThe Additional Amount will not apply if your selected Charge Currency is the same as Display Currency.\u003c/p\u003e \n\t  \u003cp\u003eWhen you click “Book Now!”, you will be charged the price shown to you in your selected Charge Currency.\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003c/td\u003e\n  \u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\n    \u003ctd style=\u0022width:30%; padding-top: 20px; padding-bottom: 20px;\u0022\u003eIf you select a \u003cstrong\u003e“Book Now, Pay Later” booking …\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\n    \u003ctd style=\u0022padding-top: 20px; padding-bottom: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd;\u0022\u003e\n\t\tAgoda will calculate an estimated price for your booking using the Bloomberg Generic Composite Rate. However, after you select your Charge Currency, the Additional Amount will be added: \n\t\t\u003cp\u003e(i) \twhen Charge Currency is different from Display Currency; and/or\u003c/p\u003e\n\t\t\u003cp\u003e(ii) when Charge Currency is different from Product Currency,\u003c/p\u003e\n\t\texcept when \u003ci\u003e(A) you are paying with a US-issuer Payment Instrument whose Payment Instrument Currency is USD; and/or (B) you are booking from an IP address located in the US, Canada, or the United Kingdom; and/or (C) you are paying with an India-issuer Payment Instrument and making your booking for Accommodations in India.\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\t\t\u003cp\u003eIf the conditions for applying both sections (i) and (ii) are met, the Additional Amount will only be applied once.\u003c/p\u003e\n\t\t\u003cp\u003eThe Additional Amount will not apply if the Display Currency, Charge Currency, and Payment Instrument Currency are in the same currency.\u003c/p\u003e\n\t\t\u003cp\u003eBecause you have selected a \u0026ldquo;Book Now, Pay Later\u0026rdquo; booking, you will not pay anything until the payment date shown on the booking form/payment information page, and on your booking confirmation.\u003c/p\u003e\n\t\t\u003cp\u003eOn the payment date, Agoda will calculate the final price for your booking in your selected Charge Currency using the Bloomberg Generic Composite Rate and, where applicable, including the Additional Amount.\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003c/td\u003e  \n  \u003c/tr\u003e\n \u003c/table\u003e\n  \u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cb\u003eREMINDER:\u003c/b\u003e Your final price on the payment date may increase (or decrease) compared to the estimated price, depending on any changes in the relevant Bloomberg Generic Composite Rates between the day that you confirm your booking and the payment date.\u003c/i\u003e\n  \u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ctable style=\u0022border-collapse: collapse; Your Payment Instrument provider may use higher or lower rates compared to the Platform.\u003c/li\u003e\n\t  \u003c/ul\u003e\n\t  \u003cp\u003eAny applicable fees are based on your agreement with your Payment Instrument provider. Agoda does not control or benefit from your Payment Instrument provider’s exchange rate or fees.\u003c/p\u003e\n    \u003c/td\u003e\n  \u003c/tr\u003e\t  \n\u003c/table\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e8.2 Charges for Taxes and Fees\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;8.2.1 When browsing Travel Products on our Platform, the Display Price is generally exclusive of taxes and service fees unless otherwise expressly stated.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;8.2.2 In connection with facilitating your booking, the charge to your Payment Instrument may include an amount for charges, taxes and fees (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eTaxes and Fees\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;) unless indicated otherwise, which may include bank and credit card fees and charges where this is available or known to us. Such bank and credit card fees and charges, where it is applicable to you, may alternatively be displayed as ‘Processing cost’ in the booking form. The charge for Taxes and Fees varies based on a number of factors including, without limitation, the amount Agoda pays the Travel Supplier and the location and type of the Travel Supplier and/or Travel Product and may include a fee that Agoda retains.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;In relation to Flights or Accommodations, these Taxes and Fees may include a fee, for the facilitation services provided by Agoda in relation to your Booking (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eAgoda Booking Fee\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;), which may also, where it is applicable to you, be displayed as a ‘Convenience Fee’ in the booking form. Except where expressly prohibited by law, the Agoda Booking Fee (including any Convenience Fee) is non-refundable.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;8.2.3 In relation to Flights and Accommodations, these Taxes and Fees include an estimated amount to recover the amount Agoda pays on your behalf to the relevant Travel Supplier(s) in connection with your booking for taxes owed by the respective Travel Supplier(s), or Agoda as the case may be, in respect of their service to you, including, without limitation, sales and use tax, occupancy tax, room tax, departure, airport use, terminal, aviation security, aviation insurance and fuel surcharges and taxes, sales tax, service tax, excise tax, value added tax, goods and services tax, consumption tax and/or other similar taxes.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;8.2.4 For bookings involving Travel Products located in certain jurisdictions, the Taxes and Fees amount may also include government-imposed service fees or other fees not paid directly to the taxing authorities but required by law to be collected by the relevant Travel Supplier, or Agoda as the case may be.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;8.2.5 In certain jurisdictions, the Taxes and Fees amount paid to the Travel Supplier on your behalf in connection with your reservation may vary from the Taxes and Fees amount Agoda estimates and includes in the charge to you. The balance of the (estimated) charge for Taxes and Fees, if any, is a fee Agoda may retain as part of the compensation:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026emsp;(a) in relation to any Flight component of your booking, as our handling fee for the services provided by Agoda to you in respect of such Flight(s); \u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026emsp;(b) in relation to any Accommodation (as applicable depending on the jurisdiction), as our fee for the services provided by Agoda to you in respect of such Accommodation. \u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;8.2.6 You are fully responsible for all taxes, charges, fees, duties and assessments arising out of the use of this Platform. While we aim to provide customers with the total price of each booking on the Platform, there is a chance that a government-imposed tax may be added or increased after the booking is purchased. If this occurs, by accepting these Terms, you agree to pay the new or higher government-imposed tax, where not prohibited by law.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;8.2.7 Except as otherwise described in these Terms, Agoda is not collecting and remitting taxes to the applicable tax authorities, unless otherwise required by law or where Agoda is required to collect and remit taxes on behalf of the Travel Suppliers. The relevant Travel Suppliers, as vendors, include all known applicable taxes in the amount displayed as the total price of your booking and Agoda pays over such amounts on your behalf directly to the vendors or directly to the relevant tax authority where required by law. Agoda is not a co-party associated with the vendors or Travel Suppliers with whom we book or reserve our customer\u0027s travel arrangements. Taxability and the appropriate tax rate and the type of applicable taxes may vary depending on various factors such as location, type of service etc.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;8.2.8 Where the Travel Product booking facilitation-related Services are provided by any Partner or made via a Partner\u0026rsquo;s platform, calculation of applicable taxes and fees will be set out in such Partner\u0026rsquo;s terms and conditions.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;8.2.9 International transaction fees\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;Your Payment Instrument provider may charge you international transaction fees (\u0026ldquo;ITF\u0026rdquo;) when you pay for your booking. The amount of ITF is solely determined by your Payment Instrument provider, and Agoda does not control or benefit from the ITF charged by your Payment Instrument provider.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e8.3 Electronically Supplied Services \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eAgoda may provide additional services independent of, in addition to, or ancillary to the Services and the services offered by the Travel Suppliers (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eElectronically Supplied Services\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo; or \u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eESS\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;). For ESS, we may request a service fee in consideration thereof, upon your acceptance of the ESS and subject to specific terms and conditions you may agree to for obtaining such ESS. For sake of clarity, such ESS fee, if charged by Agoda, will be over and above the amount you may be charged by the Travel Suppliers for availing the services offered by the Travel Suppliers.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eSome of these ESS are provided independently by third parties and not by or on behalf of Agoda. When purchasing an ESS provided by a third party through our Platform, the booking for that ESS is made directly with the Partner(s) named on the booking page and our Platform only acts as a facilitator of such booking. For ESS provided by a third party through our Platform, we may be paid a fee or commission by the relevant Partner(s).\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp class=\u0022fontsmallb\u0022\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e9. PAYMENT\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e9.1 Before you submit your Booking Request, you will be notified of the payment methods that are acceptable for that Booking Request. While most bookings are payable in full upon submission of your Booking Request (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003ePay Now\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;), we may in some cases offer you the option of paying Agoda at a later date under \u003cstrong\u003eBook Now, Pay Later\u003c/strong\u003e or \u003cstrong\u003eBook with Zero Pay\u003c/strong\u003e, or paying the Travel Supplier directly under \u003cstrong\u003ePay at Hotel\u003c/strong\u003e. Please refer to clause 15 for more details on these alternative payment options.\n\u003cp\u003e9.2 You authorize Agoda or another Agoda Group entity to charge or debit your Payment Instrument for the full booking amount once you have submitted your Booking Request.Upon receipt of your payments by Agoda for Confirmed Bookings, your obligation to the Travel Supplier for that amount is extinguished.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e9.3\tWe reserve the right to cancel your booking, including on behalf of the Travel Supplier, if applicable, if the full payment for your booking is not received by the applicable due date, including but not limited to, the following situations:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;9.3.1\tyour Payment Instrument cannot be successfully charged on the intended Charge Date for whatever reason; or\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;9.3.2\tfor Book with Zero Pay bookings, you fail to complete final payment, or your final payment fails, on or before the payment date shown on the booking form, payment information page, and your booking confirmation.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e9.4\tLocal tax invoices may be obtained from the Travel Supplier offering the Travel Product to you. Where specifically required by law, Agoda may provide a local tax invoice to you.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e9.5 For a variety of reasons, payment on our Platform may fail. YOUR OBLIGATIONS, REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e11.1 When you submit a Booking Request, you represent and warrant to Agoda that:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;11.1.1 you have the full legal capacity to make the transaction (or have the authorization to do so from your legal guardian);\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;11.1.2 the Payment Instrument you are using to make the booking is your own or that you are authorized to complete the booking with it, and that there are sufficient funds to cover the cost of the transaction;\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;11.1.3 the payment details you provide us with in making a booking are fully correct;\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;11.1.4 you or your legal guardian, where applicable, will not resell any Travel Products booked through our Platform;\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;11.1.5 you or your legal guardian, where applicable, are not subject to any international sanctions program or restrictions;\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;11.1.6 if and when applicable, you will satisfy all your obligations, tax, withholding or otherwise, as required by applicable law.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e11.2 You also undertake to provide correct and accurate e-mail, postal and/or other contact details to Agoda and acknowledge that Agoda may use these details to contact you in the event that this should prove necessary in connection with your booking or other use of our Platform.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp class=\u0022fontsmallb\u0022\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e12. PROMOTIONS \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e12.1 Agoda may support promotional rates, vouchers, discounts, promo codes and special offers (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003ePromotions\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;) and \u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eAgodaCash\u003c/strong\u003e” from time to time. While discount amounts for promocodes may vary, the value of the discount will be clearly displayed within the price breakdown.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e12.2 Where you have a promo code, or voucher, if it is not automatically applied, you must apply it on the booking form in order to apply it to your booking. In case of any dispute relating to Promotions, Agoda\u0026rsquo;s decision shall be final.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp class=\u0022fontsmallb\u0022\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e13. FRAUD \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e13.1 We have stringent fraud detection and prevention mechanisms in place. In certain cases, we may require additional information or verifications to validate and confirm your booking. If you choose not to submit the additional information or if we are not satisfied with the information received, your Booking Request will be cancelled because it is incomplete, and any amounts charged will be refunded. It is possible that a Travel Product becomes unavailable during the fraud check, in which case the booking will no longer be available. You acknowledge and agree that Agoda shall not be held liable in such circumstances.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e13.2 If you suspect an unauthorized or fraudulent booking was made using your Payment Instrument via Agoda, please contact\u0026nbsp;\u003ca href=\u0022/info/contact.html\u0022\u003eCustomer Service\u003c/a\u003e\u0026nbsp;immediately. You should also contact your bank or Payment Instrument issuer immediately upon becoming aware of such unauthorized use.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp class=\u0022fontsmallb\u0022\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e14. TRAVEL ADVISORY, VISA REQUIREMENTS AND INSURANCE \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e14.1 It is your responsibility to ensure that you satisfy all applicable legal requirements when entering a country or territory, including its visa and health requirements. As these requirements are subject to change without notice, Agoda recommends that you review travel prohibitions, warnings, announcements and advisories and verify with the appropriate consulate prior to booking and again before departure. It is your responsibility to ensure that you are either insured by your own insurance company, or by the Travel Suppliers who may provide insurance coverage. Agoda takes no responsibility in the insurance process and recommends that you are sufficiently covered with a comprehensive travel insurance policy prior to departure.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e14.2 By displaying Travel Products in or to particular destinations, Agoda does not represent or warrant that travel to such points is advisable or risk-free and Agoda shall not be held liable for damages or losses that may result from travel to such destinations. You are strongly advised to check the relevant travel advisories issued by your government for any country you are visiting and to take the necessary precautions.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e14.3 Unless otherwise stated on the Platform, prices do not include insurance. If insurance is displayed, marketed, or made available through the Platform (whether as an add on or a standalone product), you purchase it directly from the relevant third party insurer or its authorized distributor, and your contract is with that insurer, not Agoda. To the extent permitted by applicable law, the insurance may include value-added services, and details will be shown before purchase. By accessing the Platform, you acknowledge that Agoda does not underwrite, issue or administer insurance policies, nor do we guarantee the performance of any insurance product. The insurer’s policy terms and conditions govern the insurance, and these Terms do not apply to insurance. All matters relating to insurance, including claims, cancellations, refunds, coverage questions, determinations and disputes, must be directed to the insurer or any party appointed by the insurer (Agoda may only assist by referring you to the relevant party). ADDITIONAL PAYMENT OPTIONS \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e15.1 To the extent your booking includes Accommodations, you may be given the option to Book Now, Pay Later. If you have selected this option:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;15.1.1 notwithstanding clause 9.2 above, your booking amount is payable on the Charge Date which will be at such future time as indicated in the corresponding confirmation email and you authorize Agoda or another Agoda Group entity to charge or debit your Payment Instrument on such Charge Date; and\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;15.1.2 you acknowledge and agree that a small verification charge or pre-authorization may also be made to your Payment Instrument at the time the Booking Request is submitted, with the balance charged when the booking amount becomes payable by you.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e15.2 To the extent your booking includes Accommodations, you may be given the Pay at Hotel option to make payment directly at the relevant property. If you have selected this option:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;15.2.1 notwithstanding clause 8.2, the Display Price may or may not include Taxes and Fees. Please verify the booking conditions and your confirmation email or voucher, or inquire with the Travel Supplier or contact our\u0026nbsp;\u003ca href=\u0022/info/contact.html\u0022\u003eCustomer Service\u003c/a\u003e\u0026nbsp;team;\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;15.2.2 in some cases, a Travel Supplier may pre-authorize your Payment Instrument and charge a deposit or charge the full booking amount up-front; and\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;15.2.3 in some cases, a Travel Supplier may require your Payment Instrument details in order to guarantee your booking and you hereby authorise Agoda to send such information to that Travel Supplier in accordance with our\u0026nbsp;\u003ca href=\u0022/info/privacy.html\u0022\u003ePrivacy Policy\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e15.3 To the extent your booking includes Accommodations, depending on your location, you may be given the option to make payment of your booking amount in instalments (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eInstalments\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo; or \u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eDeferred Payments\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;). If you have selected this option:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;15.3.1 you acknowledge and agree that this payment option is not provided by Agoda but by a third party (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eInstalment Facilitator\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;) and subject to additional terms and conditions, including such terms and conditions as may be imposed by that Instalment Facilitator. You may be redirected to the Instalment Facilitator\u0026rsquo;s environment to complete the instalment payment option and accept Instalment-specific terms and conditions. If you do not meet the Instalment Facilitator\u0026rsquo;s terms it is at their absolute discretion to not make the instalment payment option available to you;\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;15.3.2 if you are in breach of the Instalment Facilitator\u0026rsquo;s terms, you will be subject to the consequences stipulated by the Instalment Facilitator\u0026rsquo;s terms. Agoda has no liability to you for any such consequences under these terms; and\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;15.3.3 Agoda reserves the right to cancel your booking, including on behalf of the Travel Supplier, if you breach the Instalment Facilitator’s terms and you agree to pay and be solely liable for the full booking amount. You further agree that Agoda has the right to assign the full booking amount payable by you to the Instalment Facilitator and/or its factors.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e15.4\tTo the extent (a) your booking includes Accommodations in India; (b) you are making the booking from an IP address located in India; and (c) you are paying with an India-issuer Payment Instrument, you may be given the option to Book with Zero Pay. If you have selected this option:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;15.4.1\tyou will not be required to provide your payment information when you submit your Booking Request;\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;15.4.2\tyou have the option to not pay for your booking until the payment date shown on the booking form, payment information page and your booking confirmation. However, on or before such payment date, you must log into your Agoda account and complete payment for your booking using an India-issuer Payment Instrument; and\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;15.4.3\twe may send you a reminder as the payment date approaches, but it remains your responsibility to complete payment on or before the payment date regardless of whether we send you a reminder.\u003c/p\u003e \n\u003cp class=\u0022fontsmallb\u0022\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e16. STAR RATINGS\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e16.1 Star or other denoted ratings (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003estar ratings\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;) may be displayed for some Accommodations on our Platform. Such star ratings are based on information we have received from the relevant Travel Suppliers and are provided for your information only. Agoda does not independently verify such star ratings and makes no representation that these ratings are or will be consistent with ratings on other websites and platforms. Without prejudice to the generality of clause 3.1, Agoda makes no guarantees or representations about the facilities, amenities, services, quality, comfort or any other features of any Accommodation based on the star ratings.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp class=\u0022fontsmallb\u0022\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e17. BEST PRICE GUARANTEE PROGRAM \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e17.1 We strive to have the most competitive prices and we want you to pay the lowest price possible for your stay at an Accommodation. \u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;17.1.1 Should you find your Confirmed Booking Accommodation, with the same booking specifications and conditions, at a lower price on the internet after you have made a booking through us, you may submit a claim to us in accordance with the terms of our\u0026nbsp;\u003ca href=\u0022/info/agoda-policies.html#1\u0022\u003eBest Price Guarantee\u003c/a\u003e. If we determine that your claim meets the requirements of our Best Price Guarantee, we will match the difference between the price offered on our Platform and the lower price in accordance with the terms and conditions of the Best Price Guarantee. This clause does not apply to any bookings made using the services of a Partner.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;17.1.2 In addition to the above, to fetch the best price, you allow Agoda to exercise, at our sole discretion, but without any obligation whatsoever, to re-book the same room type, with the same benefits (insofar as it satisfies the conditions above), if available at a cheaper price and reimburse you the savings in AgodaCash to your Agoda account.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp class=\u0022fontsmallb\u0022\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e18. SECRET DEALS\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e18.1 To the extent that your booking relates to an Accommodation which is part of Agoda\u0026rsquo;s Secret Deals program, you acknowledge and agree that you will only be notified of the name, location, and contact details of such Accommodation once you have a Confirmed Booking, and that such booking cannot be cancelled and is non-refundable to the extent permitted by applicable law. Accommodations that are part of the Secret Deals program come through specific arrangements with Travel Suppliers, and are indicated with a specific logo. Accommodations offered through the Secret Deals program may or may not be reflected in traditional retail inventory. When selecting and confirming such a booking, you acknowledge that your booking is made in accordance with clause 7.1.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp class=\u0022fontsmallb\u0022\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e19. FAST TRACK SERVICE\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e19.1 Agoda \u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eFast Track Service\u0026rdquo;\u003c/strong\u003e will enable you to get priority access to our customer service. At the time of your booking, you will be offered Agoda’s Fast Track Service attached to the corresponding booking. Upon completion of your purchase of the Fast Track Service, Agoda will provide you with priority access across all modes of communication with our customer service agents – calls, emails, chats – corresponding to that booking. This means that you will be put first/ahead in the queue when you contact our customer service. Please note that the Fast Track Service will be offered similarly to all purchasers, which means that Fast Track Service will be offered on first-come-first served basis if there are multiple purchasers of the same service reaching out to our customer service at the same time. In the times of emergency, force majeure, natural disaster, etc., Agoda will provide this service on best effort basis. \u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e19.2 You can avail the Fast Track Service by paying an additional amount (over and above the price of your accommodation) at the time of booking your accommodation (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eFast Track Fee\u0026rdquo;\u003c/strong\u003e). The amount of the Fast Track Fee will be calculated as a percentage of the total booking value of your selected accommodation and will be charged to you inclusive of applicable taxes. Once purchased, the Fast Track Fee will not be refunded to you in any event, including in the events of cancellation of your corresponding (fully/partially/non-refundable) booking. However, you will continue to have priority access to Agoda’s customer service, even post cancellation of your corresponding booking, should you have any questions later.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e19.3\tUpon completion of your purchase, the Fast Track Service will be available to you only with respect to the corresponding booking:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;a)\tfor departed bookings – from the time of booking creation up to 30 days after checkout date; or\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;b)\tfor cancelled bookings – from the time of booking creation up to 30 days after cancellation date.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp class=\u0022fontsmallb\u0022\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e20. SMARTFLEX SERVICE\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e20.1 Smartflex service allows you to book an accommodation with enhanced cancellation flexibility (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eExtended Cancellation Period\u0026rdquo;\u003c/strong\u003e) while making a reservation at your selected property (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eSmartflex Service\u0026rdquo;\u003c/strong\u003e). At the time of booking, amongst other offers, you may choose Smartflex Service. During the Extended Cancellation Period available to you under Smartflex Service, you can cancel your booking without any charge or cancellation fee. Cancelling your booking outside of this Extended Cancellation Period may attract cancellation fee as per the cancellation policy of the property. Both, at the time of your booking and upon completion of your purchase of the Smartflex Service, you will see the terms of the Extended Cancellation Policy corresponding to that booking.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e20.2 Smartflex Service is available to you by paying an additional amount (over and above the price of your accommodation) at the time of booking your accommodation (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eSmartflex Service Fee\u0026rdquo;\u003c/strong\u003e). Smartflex Service Fee will be disclosed to you at the time of your booking on the booking form/payment information page. In certain events, Smartflex Service Fee may not be refunded to you in case of cancellation of your associated booking.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e20.3\tBy choosing to purchase Smartflex Service offer, you agree to these Terms and all other terms made available to you at the time of your booking.\u003c/p\u003e\u003ca name=\u00225\u0022\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\n\u003cp class=\u0022fontsmallb\u0022\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e21. CANCEL FOR ANY REASON SERVICE\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e21.1\tFor eligible Accommodation and Flight bookings, Agoda has partnered with Cover Genius Singapore Pte Ltd. (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eCover Genius\u0026rdquo;\u003c/strong\u003e) who would offer an enhanced cancellation policy, called ‘Cancel for any reason’ (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eCFAR Service\u0026rdquo;\u003c/strong\u003e) independently to Agoda bookers. CFAR Service is provided, operated and managed by Cover Genius through XCover.com and not by or on behalf of Agoda. While making a reservation at an eligible Accommodation or for an eligible Flight, you may choose to add the CFAR Service as part of the Accommodation or Flight reservation. The CFAR Service allows you to cancel your Accommodation or Flight reservation at any time prior to check-in/booking commencement, in accordance with the terms of the CFAR Service and the corresponding policy issued to you by Cover Genius (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eCFAR Policy\u0026rdquo;\u003c/strong\u003e). The CFAR Service automatically expires as per the expiration date mentioned in the CFAR Policy issued to you by Cover Genius.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e21.2\tCFAR Service is made available to you by Cover Genius by you paying an additional amount (over and above the price of your Accommodation or Flight) at the time of booking your Accommodation or Flight (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eCFAR Service Fee\u0026rdquo;\u003c/strong\u003e).\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e21.3\tBy choosing to purchase and use the CFAR Service, you agree to these terms and conditions of CFAR Service, which are contained in the CFAR Policy issued to you by Cover Genius. The terms and conditions of the CFAR Service applicable to your booking, including exclusions and limitations, will be made available to you by Cover Genius at the time of your booking and upon completion of your purchase of the CFAR Service. For more information, visit \u003ca href=\u0022https://www.xcover.com/en/help/partners/agoda\u0022\u003ehelp center\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\u003ca name=\u00225\u0022\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\n\u003cp class=\u0022fontsmallb\u0022\u003e\u003cu\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eSECTION D: FLIGHTS\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/u\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp class=\u0022fontsmallb\u0022\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e22. RESCHEDULING AND CHANGES\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e22.1 To the extent that your Confirmed Booking includes any Flight(s), you acknowledge that the Travel Supplier and/or relevant airline or airlines may reschedule or cancel such Flights in accordance with the Travel Supplier Terms. Agoda is not responsible for changes to the scheduled operation of the Flights, including delayed or cancelled Flights, and any failure by the Travel Supplier to provide you with notice of changes to the Flights.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e22.2 If you wish to modify or cancel any Flight component of your Confirmed Booking, you acknowledge that in accordance with clause 10.3 above, Agoda will impose an additional charge of up to USD 50 (or the equivalent thereof in another currency) per person for each modification, except where prohibited by local law, and this is in addition to any applicable charges by Travel Suppliers and airlines. While these charges are additional, they are part of the compensation for our Services for Flights bookings.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp class=\u0022fontsmallb\u0022\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e23. FARES WITH MULTIPLE AIRLINES\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e23.1 We may offer fares that are a combination of one-way and/or return Flight segments that could involve different airlines. In processing your combined Flight booking, it is possible that certain Flight segments will be confirmed and other Flight segments for the same journey cannot be booked (or may be cancelled or significantly changed after booking). You acknowledge that each Flight segment in a combined journey is a separate flight booking. You will not be allowed to modify or cancel the confirmed Flight segments for free, even if other Flight segments for the same journey are not successfully booked. All Flight bookings are subject to terms and conditions that may vary based on the travel origin/destination, including policies on Flight booking changes and fees, cancellations, and refunds for individual or combined Flights/segments. Changes to one Flight may not automatically be applied to the other Flight segments, which may need to be changed individually. This may result in separate fees and charges to change each segment, including the Agoda Booking Fees. You may require evidence of a return or onward travel for international flights. If the bookings of all Flight segments will be confirmed, you will receive a single booking confirmation for the whole journey. The fee Agoda retains as part of the compensation for its Services and to cover the costs of booking or facilitating your reservation, is calculated based on the whole journey at the time of booking.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp class=\u0022fontsmallb\u0022\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e24.
