RANKING AND SPONSORED LISTINGS FOR ACCOMMODATIONS\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e50.1 The default ranking for Accommodations is based on an automated algorithm that may be subject to periodic updates or amendments. This ranking considers multiple factors that include, but are not limited to, the following:\u003c/p\u003e\n      \u003cul\u003e\n      \u003cli\u003eAvailability\u003c/li\u003e\n      \u003cli\u003ePromotions and rates\u003c/li\u003e\n      \u003cli\u003eHistorical popularity\u003c/li\u003e\n      \u003cli\u003eMoney earned by Agoda\u003c/li\u003e\n      \u003cli\u003eConversion (the ratio of bookings to Platform visits)\u003c/li\u003e\n      \u003cli\u003eSales of room nights\u003c/li\u003e\n      \u003cli\u003eCancellations\u003c/li\u003e\n      \u003cli\u003eQuality of content\u003c/li\u003e\n      \u003cli\u003eGuest review scores\u003c/li\u003e\n      \u003cli\u003eStar ratings\u003c/li\u003e\n      \u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e50.2 Accommodation Travel Suppliers have various opportunities, such as the Preferred Partner program or sponsored listings (i.e., pay for prime positioning in search results), to improve their visibility on the Platform. All such listings will be clearly marked and/or contain additional messaging to note their participation.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp class=\u0022fontsmallb\u0022\u003e\u003ca name=\u0022mbaph\u0022\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e51. PRIVATE HOSTS AND PROFESSIONAL TRADERS\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e51.1 Hosts which have registered with Agoda as a private host are parties that rent out their property or properties for purposes outside their trade, business, or profession. They are not officially traders (like a hotel chain) and therefore may not fall under the same consumer protection rules under EU (or other local) law.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e51.2 Properties managed by private hosts will display \u0026ldquo;Managed by a private host\u0026rdquo;. Unless stated otherwise, in situations where properties are managed by professional hosts (traders), no additional information will be displayed.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;51.2.1 \u003cstrong\u003eProfessional host (trader)\u003c/strong\u003e: Any party who rents out a property or properties for purposes relating to their primary trade business or profession (e.g., when accommodations are the main business activity, or the listing is managed by a property management company).\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026ensp;51.2.2 \u003cstrong\u003ePrivate host (non-trader)\u003c/strong\u003e: Any party who rents out a property or properties for purposes outside their primary trade business or profession (e.g., when accommodations are a side activity, or when the property is only listed seasonally/occasionally).\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp class=\u0022fontsmallb\u0022\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e52. ABOUT OUR REVIEWS\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ca name=\u0022reviews\u0022\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e52.1 Only certified guests who have booked through Agoda and not cancelled their booking are invited by Agoda to submit a review.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e52.2 Whether negative or positive, we will post every comment in full, and as quickly as possible, after being moderated to comply with the\u0026nbsp;\u003ca href=\u0022/rewards/HotelReviewGuidelines.html\u0022\u003eGuest Review Guidelines\u003c/a\u003e. Some reviews may be temporarily truncated for the sake of brevity, but anyone on our Platform can still access the entire review. Reviews may also sometimes be summarized for the sake of brevity and readability. We will also provide transparency over the status of submitted content.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e52.3 Each review score is between 1-10. Guests are able to give a separate \u0026lsquo;sub-score\u0026rsquo; in crucial areas, such as: location, cleanliness, staff, comfort, facilities, value for money and free Wi-Fi. The calculated overall score is simply an average of the sub-scores. When a review is partially submitted, we ignore the data for all sub-scores not given.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e52.4 To keep the rating score and review content relevant, we may only accept reviews that are submitted within 12 months of checking out and we may stop showing reviews older than up to 36 months, or if the Accommodation has a change of ownership.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e52.5 We may also show some review scores from other well-known travel websites. We make it clear when we have done this – for instance, reviews from Booking.com appear under a separate section of our website. We do not include sponsored reviews within our reviews.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e52.6 By default, reviews with comments are sorted based on a mix of criteria to display the most relevant reviews, including but not limited to, your language, your travel profile, readability of the review, date of submission, etc. Additional sorting options are available (by date, by rating, etc.).\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e52.7 If we find any fake reviews, we delete them and, if necessary, act against whoever is responsible. For example, if a complaint is raised against a particular review, we look at the review in question and may decide it is inappropriate if it does not meet our review guidelines or appears not to be a genuine review.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e52.8 The opinions expressed in contributions are those of Agoda customers and properties and not of Agoda. Agoda does not accept responsibility or liability for any reviews or responses. Agoda is a conduit (without any obligation to verify) and not a publisher of these comments and responses.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e52.9 At Agoda, we believe real reviews from fellow travellers provide some of the best information to help you and others make future bookings. To assure that all reviews on the Platform are relevant, helpful, and genuine, we employ strict guidelines. For further information, please see our\u0026nbsp;\u003ca href=\u0022/rewards/HotelReviewGuidelines.html\u0022\u003eGuest Review Guidelines\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp class=\u0022fontsmallb\u0022\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e53. RIGHT OF WITHDRAWAL\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ca name=\u0022right-of-withdrawal\u0022\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e53.1 The 14 days withdrawal period provided for under EU and UK consumer law do not apply to bookings made through the Platform. Instead, the ability to amend and/or cancel the booking will be governed by the cancellation and amendment rights attached to the cancellation policy type.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp class=\u0022fontsmallb\u0022\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e54. USE OF ALGORITHMS AND ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (\u0026ldquo;AI\u0026rdquo;)\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e54.1 We may deploy tools in providing and seeking to improve and develop our services that utilise algorithms and machine learning (including tools operating on a predictive basis and tools deploying generative AI algorithms to create new content)\u003c/a\u003e. These tools may interact with you (e.g., we may use chatbots or similar technology). We consider where and how to deploy these tools in line with applicable laws. In deploying such tools, we also have regard to our \u003ca href=\u0022/info/privacy.html\u0022\u003ePrivacy Policy,\u003c/a\u003e the level of human intervention or oversight we apply, further disclosures to explain the deployment and other relevant matters for the contemplated deployment.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e54.2\tIf you use the Agoda AI-powered Personal Travel Assistant, the \u0026nbsp;\u003ca href=\u0022/info/ai-assistant-terms-of-use.html\u0022\u003eAI Assistant Terms of Use\u003c/a\u003e also apply.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp class=\u0022fontsmallb\u0022\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e55. ACCESSIBILITY STATEMENT FOR AGODA\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e \n\u003cp\u003eAt Agoda, we are committed to making our platform accessible for everyone. We strive to deliver barrier-free, inclusive digital experiences for all users, including persons with disabilities.\u003c/p\u003e \n\u003cp\u003eWe are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our digital services. The statement in this clause 55 (the \u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eAccessibility Statement\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;) has been prepared to inform users about how we make our services accessible in accordance with the requirements set out in the European Accessibility Act (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eEAA\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;). This includes aligning with the currently applicable EU standard on accessibility requirements for ICT products and services (EN 301 549) and the WCAG level AA version 2.1 (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eAccessibility Standards\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;). This Accessibility Statement applies to our in-scope EAA services.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e55.1 Description of the services\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eAgoda enables users in the EU to search, book, and manage accommodation bookings (for purposes of this Accessibility Statement, each a “Travel Product”) through its digital platforms, including the website, mobile web, iOS, and Android applications. This Accessibility Statement outlines our commitment to improve the accessibility of our digital services and our alignment with applicable EU Accessibility Standards. Specifically, we are committed to deliver:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003ePerceivable content: all visual and auditory information is presented in ways that are adaptable to users\u0027 needs.\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003eOperable interface: the service is fully navigable by keyboard and works seamlessly with assistive technologies such as screen readers.\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003eUnderstandable design: our interface uses clear and simple language; it avoids unnecessary complexity.\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003eRobust content: we will endeavor to ensure compatibility with current and future user agents, including assistive technologies.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e55.2 Measures to support accessibility\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIn order to deliver accessible Travel Products, we have taken the following measures to provide more accessible services:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003ea) Technical measures on platform:\u003c/strong\u003e We are taking the following technical measures to bring the Agoda platform in conformity with the EAA accessibility requirements:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003eText-based descriptions: detailed written information available in clear and simple language.\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003eScreen reader compatibility: functional with popular screen readers including VoiceOver, TalkBack, NVDA, JAWS.\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003eAccessible Rich Internet Applications (“ARIA”) use: implementation of ARIA roles and attributes.\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003eMultimedia alternatives: subtitles, transcripts, and alternative text accompanying all visual and multimedia content, where applicable.\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003eHigh-contrast and zoom functionality: compatible with adjustable contrast and text scaling settings and capabilities, for users with visual disabilities.\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003eSimple navigation: logical layouts with consistent headings, landmarks, and menus.\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003eKeyboard accessibility: all functions can be operated via keyboard.\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003eHelp and support: step-by-step content in accessible formats.\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003eError notifications: clear and descriptive error messages to guide users in resolving issues.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eb) Training and education:\u003c/Strong\u003e We are supporting our employees with having the skills required to keep our services in conformity with the Accessibility Standards by delivering online training courses made available for designers and developers on accessibility best practices.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003ec) Inclusive design, writing and research practices:\u003c/strong\u003e We are considering accessibility as early as possible in the service provision lifecycle. To support this, Agoda has built a Figma plugin that adds accessibility annotations to designs prior to developer hand-off. This means developers have all the details they need in order to implement the design accessibly. We also conduct research and test our products with people with disabilities. Additionally, accessibility requirements are documented and addressed at the scoping and requirements phase.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003ed) Testing \u0026amp; quality assurance (\u0026ldquo;QA\u0026rdquo;) processes:\u003c/strong\u003e We are committed to embedding accessibility testing practices within our development and QA processes. This way we are able to continually test our services against the latest Accessibility Standards and detect accessibility issues in our code. The QA processes consist of:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003eAutomated testing: utilising third-party tooling to embed accessibility tests into pipeline testing and release processes. Additionally, we perform daily automated scans of our web platforms to detect accessibility issues proactively.\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003eManual testing: ad-hoc manual testing performed as part of development and QA processes in pre- and post-production.\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003eAssistive technology lab: accessibility teams have access to a range of devices set up with assistive technologies to easily test their products.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003ee) Auditing and evaluation:\u003c/strong\u003e We conduct regular internal and external auditing to understand our performance:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003eThird-party audits: periodic assessments by external accessibility experts, across all our platforms (web and app).\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003eRecord keeping: internal reporting on accessibility conformance.\u003c/li\u003e\t\n\t\u003cli\u003eSelf-audits: self-audit mechanisms to address coverage not captured in external audits.\u003c/li\u003e\t\n\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003c/p\u003e\u003cstrong\u003ef) Centralised accessibility support:\u003c/strong\u003e We established a centralised accessibility team to provide guidance and support to all product teams. Additionally, we established a cross - functional group to support accessibility efforts across the company and spread awareness.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003c/p\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e55.3 Feedback and Contact Information\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe welcome your feedback on the accessibility of Agoda’s platform. If you experience any accessibility issues or have suggestions to improve the accessibility of our services, please leave your comments in our \u003ca href=\u0022https://agoda-accessibility.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new\u0022\u003eAccessibility Feedback Form\u003c/a\u003e. For all booking-related inquiries, please contact our \u003ca href=\u0022/info/contact.html\u0022\u003eCustomer Service\u003c/a\u003e team.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIf you have any questions about your Travel Product, please contact the service provider of the Travel Product (including but not limited to the owner of a hotel or other property).\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e55.4\tWe are committed to fostering an inclusive digital environment and continuously improving the accessibility of our platform. While we strive to meet applicable accessibility standards and regulations to the best of our ability, we acknowledge that full compliance is an ongoing journey. We regularly review and update our accessibility practices, guided by recognized frameworks and user feedback, to ensure reasonable efforts are made toward creating an accessible experience for all users. We welcome any questions, feedback, or requests for assistance and encourage you to contact us so we can address your needs promptly.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e55.5\tThis Accessibility Statement is last updated on 24 March 2026.\u003c/p\u003e","301504":"Due to regulations, we are unable to provide online activity bookings in the country you are currently in. For relevant information on such prices, currency selections, and currency-related charges, please review the table below in its entirety:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ctable border=\u00221\u0022\u003e\n\u003ctbody\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\n\u003ctd width=\u0022162\u0022\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003ea) Certain Definitions\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd width=\u0022462\u0022\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e(i)\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; \u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eCard Currency\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo; means the default currency of the Payment Instrument you use to pay for a booking.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e(ii)\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; \u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eCharge Currency\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo; means the currency in which you are charged for a booking, which you may have the option to change.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e(iii)\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; \u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eDisplay Currency\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo; means the currency in which the Platform displays listing prices to you for your reference. You may select your Display Currency from various options on the Platform.\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e(iv)\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; \u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eProduct Currency\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo; means the currency in which the Travel Supplier provides its prices to Agoda Group, for its Travel Product listings. The Product Currency is the official currency in the territory where the relevant Travel Product is located or provided, unless the Travel Supplier or Agoda Group, as the case may be, requests otherwise.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e(v)\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; \u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eBloomberg Rate\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo; means the applicable Bloomberg Generic Composite Rate mid-rate on the then-current day. Other relevant definitions are also incorporated into the clauses below.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eREMINDER\u003c/strong\u003e: The price ultimately charged to you will be a price in the selected Charge Currency.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\n\u003ctd width=\u0022162\u0022\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e(b) When different currencies are involved, how are the listing prices displayed on the Platform, and the amount ultimately charged to me, calculated?\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd width=\u0022462\u0022\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e(i)\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; \u003cu\u003eProduct Price\u003c/u\u003e. The price of each Travel Product listing on the Platform is based on the price provided by the Travel Supplier in the Product Currency (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eProduct Price\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;). The then-current Bloomberg Rate is generally used to: \u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003ea)\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; calculate, from the Product Price, the price displayed to you in your Display Currency (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eDisplay Price\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;), if the Product Currency is different from your Display Currency; and\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eb)\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; calculate, from the Product Price, the price charged to you and due in your Charge Currency (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eCharge Price\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;), if the Product Currency is different from your Charge Currency.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e(ii)\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; \u003cu\u003ePreliminary Display Price\u003c/u\u003e. Before selecting your Charge Currency, the Display Price is only a preliminary estimate for your convenient reference and does not reflect the price increases described below or any fluctuations of the Bloomberg Rate. You should always double-check the Charge Price after selecting your Charge Currency.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\n\u003ctd width=\u0022162\u0022\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e(c) What currencies may be selected as my Display Currency or Charge Currency?\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd width=\u0022462\u0022\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e(i)\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; \u003cu\u003eSelecting Display Currency.\u003c/u\u003e\u0026nbsp;You may select your Display Currency from the multiple currency options on the Platform.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e(ii)\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; \u003cu\u003eSelecting Charge Currency\u003c/u\u003e. If your Display Currency is different from your Card Currency, you may have the option to select your Display Currency or Card Currency as your Charge Currency. Your Card Currency will be determined based on the card information you enter. If your Display Currency is the same as your Card Currency, your Card Currency will automatically be selected as your Charge Currency, unless it is indicated otherwise.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eREMINDER\u003c/strong\u003e: Your Charge Price may be increased depending on the currency(ies) selected as your Charge Currency and Display Currency.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\n\u003ctd width=\u0022162\u0022\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e(d) \u003cu\u003eHow could the amount charged to me be increased based on my currency selections\u003c/u\u003e?\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd width=\u0022462\u0022\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e(i)\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; \u003cu\u003eDisplay Currency-Related\u003c/u\u003e. \u003cstrong\u003e\u003cu\u003eIf your Charge Currency is different from your Display Currency, an additional 5% will be applied to your Charge Price\u003c/u\u003e\u003c/strong\u003e\u003cu\u003e.\u003c/u\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e(ii)\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; \u003cu\u003eProduct Currency-Related\u003c/u\u003e. You may make a booking with Pay Later or an equivalent option selected (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003ePay Later Booking\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;), in which case you would make such booking on a certain date (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eBooking Date\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;) but would be charged for such booking on a later date (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eCharge Date\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;). \u003cstrong\u003e\u003cu\u003eIf your Charge Currency is different from the Product Currency for a Pay Later Booking, your Charge Price will be calculated from the Product Price using the Bloomberg Rate plus five percent (\u0026ldquo;Bloomberg +5%\u0026rdquo;) on the Charge Date\u003c/u\u003e\u003c/strong\u003e. If the conditions for applying both section (i) above and this section (ii) are otherwise met, only the price increase described in this section (ii) would be applied. \u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e\u003cu\u003eIn respect of the above, an intermediary currency, typically USD, may be used in the calculation of currency amounts\u003c/u\u003e\u003c/strong\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e.\u003c/strong\u003e As such, please note that the Charge Price may be calculated from the Product Price by first arriving at a USD amount from the Product Price (e.g. on the Booking Date) and then arriving at the Charge Price from that USD amount (e.g. on the Charge Date). \u003cstrong\u003eNote that a difference in USD exchange rate can occur for which we do not take responsibility\u003c/strong\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\n\u003ctd width=\u0022162\u0022\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e(e) On Property Collect Bookings \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd width=\u0022462\u0022\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWhere the Travel Product is an Accommodation and you make a Property Collect booking (as defined further below), your total price will be updated to show the amount you will pay in the Product Currency. You will pay the Travel Supplier directly, in the Product Currency or any other currency the Travel Supplier agrees to accept. If you pay in a different currency, or with a Payment Instrument that uses a different currency, the actual amount you will be charged for your booking will depend on the exchange rate(s) used by the Travel Supplier and your payment providers. These factors are outside of our control.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\n\u003ctd width=\u0022162\u0022\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e(f) Payment Instrument provider\u0026rsquo;s exchange rate and fees\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd width=\u0022462\u0022\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eBased on your agreement with your Payment Instrument provider (for example, the bank issuing the payment card which you use to pay), your Payment Instrument provider may charge additional fees (e.g., international transaction fees) or, if your Charge Currency is different from your Card Currency, your Payment Instrument provider will determine the applicable exchange rate when the transaction is applied to your account. Your Payment Instrument provider may offer a higher or lower rate compared to the Platform. We do not control or benefit from your Payment Instrument provider\u0026rsquo;s exchange rate or fees.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/tbody\u003e\n\u003c/table\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e8.2\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; Charges for Taxes and Fees\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e8.2.1\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; When browsing Travel Products on our Platform, \u003cstrong\u003ethe Display Price is generally exclusive of taxes and service fees unless otherwise expressly stated\u003c/strong\u003e. You may change the Display Price to include taxes and service fees in the settings on our Platform. Please note that the \u003cstrong\u003eaccommodations in certain jurisdictions will charge you other taxes at the property which cannot be charged by us according to the applicable laws\u003c/strong\u003e, and such taxes charged at the property will not be included in the total price (including taxes and service fees) you paid to us.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e8.2.2\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; In connection with facilitating your booking, the charge to your Payment Instrument may include an amount for charges, taxes and fees (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eTaxes and Fees\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;) unless indicated otherwise, which may include bank and credit card fees and charges where this is available or known to us. The charge for Taxes and Fees varies based on a number of factors including, without limitation, the amount Agoda Group pays the Travel Supplier and the location and type of the Travel Supplier and/or Travel Product and may include a fee that Agoda Group retains.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIn relation to Flights or Accommodations, subject to applicable laws and regulations, these Taxes and Fees may include a fee for the facilitation services provided by Agoda Group in relation to your Booking (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eAgoda Booking Fee\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;). Except where expressly prohibited by law, the Agoda Booking Fee is non-refundable.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e8.2.3\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; In relation to Flights and Accommodations, these Taxes and Fees include an estimated amount to recover the amount Agoda Group pays on your behalf to the relevant Travel Supplier(s) in connection with your booking for taxes owed by the respective Travel Supplier(s), or Agoda Group as the case may be, in respect of their service to you, including, without limitation, sales and use tax, occupancy tax, room tax, departure, airport use, terminal, aviation security, aviation insurance and fuel surcharges and taxes, sales tax, service tax, excise tax, value added tax, goods and services tax, consumption tax and/or other similar taxes.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e8.2.4\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; For bookings involving Travel Products located in certain jurisdictions, the Taxes and Fees amount may also include government-imposed service fees or other fees not paid directly to the taxing authorities but required by law to be collected by the relevant Travel Supplier, or Agoda Group as the case may be.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e8.2.5\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; In certain jurisdictions, the Taxes and Fees amount paid to the Travel Supplier on your behalf in connection with your reservation may vary from the Taxes and Fees amount Agoda Group estimates and includes in the charge to you. The balance of the (estimated) charge for Taxes and Fees, if any, is a fee Agoda Group may retain as part of the compensation:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003col\u003e\n\u003cli\u003ea) in relation to any Flight component of your booking, as our handling fee for the services provided by Agoda Group to you in respect of such Flight(s);\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eb) in relation to any Accommodation (as applicable depending on the jurisdiction), as our fee for the services provided by Agoda Group to you in respect of such Accommodation.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ol\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e8.2.6\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; You are fully responsible for all taxes, charges, fees, duties and assessments arising out of the use of this Platform. If this occurs, by accepting these Terms, you agree to pay the new or higher government-imposed tax, where not prohibited by law.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e8.2.7\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; Except as otherwise described in these Terms, Agoda Group is not the vendor collecting and remitting taxes to the applicable tax authorities, unless otherwise required by law or where Agoda Group is required to collect and remit taxes on behalf of the Travel Suppliers. The relevant Travel Suppliers, as vendors, include all known applicable taxes in the amount displayed as the total price of your booking and Agoda Group pays over such amounts on your behalf directly to the vendors or directly to the relevant tax authority where required by law. Agoda Group is not a co-vendor associated with the vendors with whom we book or reserve our customer\u0027s travel arrangements. Taxability and the appropriate tax rate and the type of applicable taxes may vary depending on various factors such as location, type of service etc.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e8.2.8\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; Where the Travel Product booking facilitation-related Services are provided by any Third Party Partner or made via a Third Party Partner\u0026rsquo;s platform, calculation of applicable taxes and fees will be set out in such Third Party Partner\u0026rsquo;s terms and conditions.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e8.3\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; Electronically Supplied Services\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eAgoda may provide additional services independent of, in addition to, or ancillary to the Services and the services offered by the Travel Suppliers (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eElectronically Supplied Services\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo; or \u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eESS\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;). For these ESS, we may request a service fee in consideration thereof, upon your acceptance of these ESS and subject to specific terms and conditions you may agree to for obtaining such ESS. For sake of clarity, such ESS fee if charged by Agoda will be over and above the amount you may be charged by the Travel Suppliers for availing the services offered by the Travel Suppliers.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003col start=\u00229\u0022\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e PAYMENT\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ol\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e9.1\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; Before you submit your Booking Request, you will be notified of the payment methods that are acceptable for that Booking Request. While most bookings are payable in full upon submission of your Booking Request (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003ePay Now\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;), we may in some cases offer you the option of paying Agoda Group at a later date (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eBook Now, Pay Later\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;) or paying the Travel Supplier directly (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003eProperty Collect\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;). Please refer to clause 15 for more details on these alternative payment options.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e9.2\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; You authorize Agoda or another Agoda Group entity to charge or debit your Payment Instrument for the full booking amount once you have submitted your Booking Request.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e9.3\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; We reserve the right to cancel your booking, including on behalf of the Travel Supplier, if applicable, if the full payment for your booking is not received in a timely fashion, including but not limited to where your Payment Instrument cannot be charged on the intended Charge Date for whatever reason.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e9.4\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; Local tax invoices may be obtained from the Travel Supplier offering the Travel Product to you in most cases. In some cases where Quantum provides booking facilitation service to you and collects payment from you, Quantum will provide you with the relevant tax invoice according to the applicable laws. Where other merchants provide booking facilitation service to you via the Platform and collects payment from you, such merchants will provide tax invoices or receipts to you in accordance with the applicable laws in the merchant\u0026rsquo;s jurisdiction.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e9.5\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; For a variety of reasons, payment on our Platform may fail. If you have any questions, please contact \u003ca href=\u0022https://www.agoda.com/info/contact.html\u0022\u003eCustomer Service\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003col start=\u002210\u0022\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e CANCELLATIONS, CHANGES AND REFUNDS\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ol\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e10.1\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; If you wish to review, adjust or cancel your reservation, please follow the instructions in the confirmation email, use our self-service tool, or contact \u003ca href=\u0022https://www.agoda.com/info/contact.html\u0022\u003eCustomer Service\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e10.2\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; Any cancellations, changes, refunds and no-shows to your Confirmed Booking are subject to the applicable booking conditions and Travel Supplier Terms, including any additional fees that may be imposed by the Travel Supplier. \u003cstrong\u003eYou should read our \u003c/strong\u003e\u003ca href=\u0022https://www.agoda.com/info/agoda-policies.html\u0022\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eRefund Policy\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e, the cancellation and no-show policies of the relevant Travel Supplier(s), and the booking conditions for your selected reservation carefully prior to making your booking\u003c/strong\u003e. Please be advised that certain reservations may be non-refundable, non-cancellable, and/or non-changeable.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e10.3\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; Without prejudice to clause 10.2, we reserve the right to charge a cancellation and/or modification fee on behalf of the Travel Supplier, up to the full cost of the reservation, for any cancellation or modification by you of a Confirmed Booking, and such fees will be indicated on our Platform.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003col start=\u002211\u0022\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e YOUR OBLIGATIONS, REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ol\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e11.1\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; When you submit a Booking Request, you represent and warrant to Agoda Group that:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e11.1.1 you are 18 years of age or older (or such other age at which majority is reached in your country or territory) and have the full legal capacity to make the transaction (or have the authorization to do so from your legal guardian);\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e11.1.2 \u003cstrong\u003ethe Payment Instrument you are using to make the booking is your own or that you are authorized to complete the booking with it\u003c/strong\u003e, and that there are sufficient funds to cover the cost of the transaction;\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e11.1.3 the payment details and the guest/passenger name you provide us with in making a booking are fully correct (the guest/passenger name you provide must be same as the ID/passport name of the actual guest/passengers, otherwise the Travel Supplier may deny the guest/passenger\u0026rsquo;s check-in/ boarding);\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e11.1.4 you can only make a Booking for the purpose of non-commercial personal use, and \u003cstrong\u003eyou shall not resell any Travel Products booked through our Platform or book an unreasonably large number of Travel Products\u003c/strong\u003e;\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e11.1.5 you are not subject to any international sanctions program or restrictions;\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e11.1.6 if and when applicable, you will satisfy all your obligations, tax, withholding or otherwise, as required by applicable law.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e11.2\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; You also undertake to provide correct and accurate e-mail, postal and/or other contact details to Agoda Group and acknowledge that we may use these details to contact you in the event that this should prove necessary in connection with your booking or other use of our Platform.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003col start=\u002212\u0022\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e PROMOTIONS, CROSS-OUT RATES, INVENTORY\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ol\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e12.1\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; We may support promotional rates, vouchers, discounts, promo codes and special offers (\u0026ldquo;\u003cstrong\u003ePromotions\u003c/strong\u003e\u0026rdquo;) and \u0026ldquo;AgodaCash\u0026rdquo; from time to time. Unless expressly stated otherwise, Promotions may not be combined with other Promotions and/or loyalty programs. Promotions are subject to further rules and special conditions which will be posted on our Platform, as may be amended by us from time to time. Promotions cannot be redeemed, exchanged or refunded for cash, credit, or other products. Unless expressly stated otherwise, Promotions will not apply to the local taxes, service fees and additional charges of your booking.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e12.3\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; To the maximum extent permitted by applicable laws, we reserve the right to stop the use of any Promotion for any reason. In case of any dispute relating to Promotions, our decision shall be final.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e12.4\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; \u003cstrong\u003eThe crossed-out rates on our Platform (if any) are the reference rates (including a standard rate, a rack rate, or a suggested retail rate provided by Travel Suppliers, a rate historically transacted on Agoda Platform, and a rate supported by other facts) of Travel Products, not the original prices of Travel Products\u003c/strong\u003e.\u0026nbsp; Non-crossed-out rates (regardless of how such rates are displayed on the Platform) are the real time sell rates of Travel Products.\u0026nbsp; The total amount you finally pay for a booking is affected by various factors (such as Promotions or AgodaCash being redeemed) and will be displayed to you at the bottom of the payment page.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e12.5\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; Prices and inventories (including the sold-out status) of a particular Travel Product as displayed on Agoda Platform are the real time prices and inventories available on the Platform, and are not the prices and inventories available via all booking channels (online and offline, including these offered by the Travel Suppliers directly to its consumers).\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003col start=\u002213\u0022\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e FRAUD\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ol\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e13.1\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; We have stringent fraud detection and prevention mechanisms in place. Providing this information is entirely optional, and choosing not to share it will not affect your ability to use the platform or complete your bookings.\u003c/td\u003e\n\t\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/table\u003e\n\u003ca name=\u0022what_personal_data_do_we_collect_about_you\u0022\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e1. What personal data do we collect about you?\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe collect personal data about you when you interact with or use our Platform to make a booking, explore or make plans related to an accommodation, flight, activity (such as tours or other travel activities) or other services that we may make available through our Platform or otherwise (such as partners’ websites and social media) (each a \u0022Travel Product”). If you plan, save or make a booking for any Travel Product with other guests, or on behalf of someone else, or if you provide us with any of your travel plans, it is your responsibility to ensure that the guests or any other third parties are aware and have acknowledged that Agoda will use their personal data as described in this Privacy Policy.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eInformation we may collect from you and your interactions with our Platform\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eIdentification and account data\u003c/strong\u003e – such as Booking ID, your (and/or each of your guest’s) name, email address, phone number, date of birth, gender, media (including images you decide to upload e.g. when leaving a review).\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eTravel Product Booking Data\u003c/strong\u003e - such as payment details, Travel Supplier’s name \u0026amp location, itinerary and depending on the Travel Product booking made, the length of stay, prices, the date of your booking, and other details of your itinerary (including if you or your guest(s) will arrive via air, sea or rail, arrival/departure times, pick up/drop off location), information about additional services purchased with the Travel Suppliers, such as extra baggage, upgrades, preferred tour/activity language, special dietary and accessibility needs, physical characteristics such as height, weight, mobile device models, IMEI numbers, SIM activation dates, other information about any other special preferences or requirements that Travel Suppliers may need to consider in connection with your (and your guests’) Travel Product booking (including, child safety information) and travel plans or options and their related details or preferences.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eCommunications data \u003c/strong\u003e - If you need to get in touch with our customer support team or communicate with your Travel Supplier through our Platform, we will collect the information you share with us through the communication channels we make available (e.g. email, phone, in-app or platform messages, chatbots, Agoda’s AI powered travel assistant, social media messaging apps).\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIf you contact our customer service team via social media messaging apps such as (e.g.  Whatsapp/Meta, Line, Kakao, WeChat etc.), the information you share with us may include your username, phone number, or other profile information. This is controlled by your social media messaging app provider or as authorized by you via your privacy settings there – please review their privacy policies before using their app to contact us.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eReviews and survey data\u003c/strong\u003e – If you submit reviews on the Platform, we collect and may publish your personal data such as your review, your first name, media (photos or, videos), country of residence.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eMembership data\u003c/strong\u003e – such as information on loyalty or similar programs in place with your Travel Supplier and your Agoda account password when you create an Agoda account.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eOnline behavior data\u003c/strong\u003e – when you visit our Platform, we may automatically gather certain data such as your IP address, the date and time of access, and information about your device’s hardware and software, including the operating system, browser type, software or application version, and language preferences.  If you are using a mobile device, we also collect information specific to your device, including its unique identifiers, settings, and characteristics, as well as data related to app crashes and other system activities. We also record the way you used to make bookings (e.g., mobile website, desktop website, or app used), as well as the source website or platform that directed you to us. We also collect data on your interactions, such as the pages you view and the links you click, for example through cookies -read more in the \u003ca href=\u0022#cookies\u0022\u003e\u0026ldquo;Cookies\u0026rdquo; section\u003c/a\u003e below.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eLocation data\u003c/strong\u003e - You may choose to grant us access to your location data to enable us to provide the services you request, such as searching for Travel Products near you. Additionally, when uploading a picture from your mobile device, it may include location data as part of the tagging process.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eGovernment issued identification data\u003c/strong\u003e – such as your (or your guests’) passport or national ID number, driver’s license, country of issue, expiry date, nationality, visas. Some of these information are among the Uniquely Identifying Information (UII),  these information is processed under legal authorization (such as for flight arrangement) or with your consent.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eSpecial programs and promotions data\u003c/strong\u003e - from time to time, Agoda may offer programs or promotions on our Platform, alone or together with third parties as detailed in the \u003ca href=\u0022#who_do_we_share_data_with\u0022\u003esection \u0026ldquo;Who do we share your personal data with\u0026rdquo;.\u003c/a\u003e If you participate in one of these programs or make a booking through a dedicated landing page, we may collect additional information to facilitate the booking as further required and indicated in the program or promotion.\n\u003cp\u003eSome of these programs may be initiatives carried out in conjunction with certain government agencies. In such case we may collect, store, process and disclose the personal data we have on you together with such other additional data elements including, but not limited to your national identification document, visa application, nationality, or date of birth as may be necessary to comply with the requirements set by the relevant government agencies for the specific programs. Please do not participate in the respective programs or promotions if you do not want your data to be processed by Agoda and, if applicable, disclosed to the relevant government agencies or their representatives for such purposes.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eSensitive Personal Data:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eCertain types of personal data, such as religion, health related data or children’s data, are considered sensitive and may require additional protection under applicable laws. Although we do not ordinarily collect sensitive personal data as part of our standard Travel Product bookings, there may be a need , from time to time, to collect such information e.g. as contained in a government-issued identification document or medical certificate (e.g. if such information is supportive of a transaction or request that you ask us to perform on your behalf such as a cancellation or amendment of your booking, as part of  legal requirements (e.g. mobility, accessibility or other special travel preferences) or if you may choose to share such information voluntarily through any contact you may have with Agoda. You may also elect to provide us with other information which may imply or suggest information like religion, health or other information, such as when specifying your dietary needs.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eUnless requested by our customer service team, we discourage you from providing sensitive personal data  (yours or of other Guest or third parties) on any of our customer support channels.  This extends to any other communication channels we may make available (e.g. email, phone, in-app or platform messages, chatbots, Agoda’s AI powered travel assistant or other trip planning or saving features, social media messaging apps).  If you choose to disclose this data, we will treat this as you having given your explicit consent to Agoda for use of that information as described in this Privacy Policy.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eChildren\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eOur Platform is not directed towards children or people under the legal age of majority where our Platform is accessed.  If parents or guardians provide us with information about children, we may collect it to facilitate a Travel Product booking, provide related services or for other exceptional circumstances (such as features addressed to families). This will only be used and collected as provided by the parent or guardian.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIf you are a parent or guardian and believe we may have collected personal data from a minor other than as contemplated above, please notify us to request that we remove that personal data.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eInformation we may collect from third parties\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThese can include Travel Suppliers, affiliated group companies, service providers and other independent third parties. Information we receive from these third  parties may be used together with other information about you.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eFor example, Travel Suppliers or business partners may share certain information about you with us, such as your name and email address, your address, payment details and other relevant information  to facilitate your Travel Product booking, (including questions or any related disputes) and to identify the channel from which your booking originated.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIf you access or sign in to our Platform through social media service providers, such as Meta (Facebook, Whatsapp), Google,  Kakao, etc., we may receive information about you such as your username and other information you may make available to us via such services.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe also integrate with payment services providers to facilitate payments between you and Travel Suppliers. They may share payment information so we can facilitate your Travel Product booking.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe may also receive information such as additional cookie data, which our service providers, such as advertising partners, may make available to us.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIn some cases, we may provide links to other websites or mobile apps that are not owned or operated by us (\u0026ldquo;Third Party Websites\u0026rdquo;). When you click on these Third-Party Websites, such third parties may share certain personal data related to you or your interactions on these Third-Party Websites with us in accordance with their privacy policies. You will be subject to that Third-Party Websites’ privacy and security practices, which may differ from ours.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe encourage you to carefully review the privacy and cookie policies of any Third-Party Websites you use to understand how your personal data is managed and shared by them, and what controls you might have over your data with such third parties. We have no control over, and are not responsible for, the content, services, or privacy and security practices of any Third-Party Websites.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ca name=\u0022how_do_we_use_your_personal_data\u0022\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e2. How do we use your personal data?\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe use your information for several purposes;\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eTo facilitate a Travel Product booking and related requests:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe may use your personal data to provide you with the requested services, such as creating a user account, processing and confirming your booking, planning, saving your Travel Bookings or plans, and communicating with you about services requested such as pre-booking or post booking customer support, to deal with special requests, responding to any questions you may have, helping you to contact the right Travel Supplier or business partner for amendments, cancellations, and rewards.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eTo communicate with you:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe may get in touch with you through email, text, phone call, social media channels or through push notifications after you book with us on our Platform to confirm your booking, to remind you of your upcoming bookings or to inform you of important messages or instructions relating to your bookings.  To manage Cashback Rewards, we may send you notifications to inform you of your eligibility, reward balance and to remind you of upcoming expiry dates. These are part of your booking process and are not marketing messages. You will continue to receive them, even if you have opted out of our marketing messages. If you are making a booking for another person, you also have the option to insert the guest’s email address for the purpose of the guest receiving the booking confirmation.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eSimilarly, opting into receiving Price Alerts will not affect any other choices you have made regarding receiving communications from us. If you elect to receive Price Alerts, you will be able to opt out of receiving the same by clicking on the “turn off price alerts” or a similar message found in the Price Alert sent to you.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIf you have not finalized a booking online, we may send you up to two reminders to continue with your booking. We believe that this additional service is useful to you because it allows you to carry on with a booking without having to search for the booking again or fill in all the booking details from scratch. Booking information used for such reminders will be deleted from our systems in accordance with our data retention policy detailed below.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eTo enable your use of Agoda’s AI powered travel assistant\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eAs further described in our \u003ca href=\u0022/info/ai-assistant-terms-of-use.html\u0022\u003eAgoda\u0027s AI powered travel assistant Terms of Use\u003c/a\u003e, our AI powered travel assistant  can be used to explore travel options and plan your travel on the Platform including identifying available Travel Products available from Travel Suppliers on the Platform and make suggestions for your itinerary.  It allows you to start a separate chat for each trip you wish to plan (\u0022Conversation Thread\u0022). If you use Agoda\u0027s AI powered travel assistant, it will collect data you input or link through a Conversation Thread and retain and build upon that data throughout the Conversation Thread. Agoda\u0027s AI powered travel assistant uses third party hosted products including large language model tools to process this data together with other data about your past booking details to build a profile about your travel preferences that is applied in responding to you in that Conversation Thread. Do not input any sensitive data, such as credit card details, and we strongly urge you to limit the data you input to what is strictly necessary.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe may review Conversation Threads as part of monitoring the performance of our AI powered travel assistant (e.g., for quality assurance purposes) and making improvements.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eTo send you marketing communication or provide you with tailored advertisements or suggestions:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe use your personal data to send you marketing communications of products, services, news, offers, promotion or surveys that may be relevant to you.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eSubject to your choices, the marketing channels we may use to communicate with you are email, SMS, mobile messaging apps (e.g., WhatsApp, Line, Messenger, KakaoTalk), push notifications when you have installed the Agoda app on your device and interest-based advertising, tailored content and ads, delivered through our Platform and Third-Party Websites,  apps, or social media platforms based on your interactions on this and other sites or apps or social media platforms. The marketing channels we use to communicate with you will depend on your choices, such as the communication platforms you use if you have opted to join an Agoda group on that channel, and the settings you have in place for the channel. Our ability to communicate with you through one of these marketing channels may also depend on the settings you have in place for the channel. Please read the instructions of the specific channel or your mobile device to understand how to change the settings and enable the sharing of such information. For instance, you may change the setting of your mobile device to opt out of receiving push notifications (including Software Development Kit (\u0026ldquo;SDK\u0026rdquo;) and push token data). Different device operating systems may have varying default settings, so it is important to familiarize yourself with these settings governing e.g. push notifications.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eYou can withdraw your consent from receiving marketing communications from us at any time by using the \u0026ldquo;Unsubscribe\u0026rdquo; link, through your device settings, your Agoda account (depending on the channel you are trying to withdraw your consent from), or other withdrawal mechanism provided forin the relevant our marketing communication channels.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWhere required by law and subject to your choices, we may also show you personalized advertisements on our Platform, including promotions, travel options or suggestions, surveys, or any other updates about our Travel Products, based on what we think you may find interesting. \u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eTo maintain, operate and improve our Platforms:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe may use your personal data to maintain and improve your user experience and our Platform to keep it updated and relevant, and to ensure compliance with the Agoda Platform Terms of Use are complied with. We may generate statistics about our business  to conduct internal training or to inform our marketing strategy, provide you with tailored content based on your interactions both here  and on other websites, apps, and social media platforms.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eTo provide you with communication channels:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe may offer you and certain Travel Suppliers various channels to communicate with each other about your booking(s) via our Platform.  We may access communications on any channels we make available and may use automated systems to review, scan, and analyze communications for security purposes; fraud prevention; compliance with legal and regulatory requirements; investigations of potential misconduct; product development and improvement; research; customer engagement, including to provide you with information and offers that we believe may be of interest to you; and customer or technical support.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe reserve the right to block the delivery of, or review communications on the channels that we, in our sole discretion, believe may contain malicious content, spam, or may pose a risk to you or to Travel Suppliers, us, or others. All communications sent or received using a Platform supplied communication channel will be received and stored by us.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eNote that business partners, through whose platform you made a booking and Travel Suppliers may choose to communicate with you directly via email or other channels that are beyond our control.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eTo provide you with a safe and trustworthy service:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe use personal data for risk assessment and security purposes, including for the purposes of detecting and preventing fraud and harm when you report a safety concern, for the authentication of users and bookings, or when others report a fraud or safety incident about you. When we do this, we may have to stop or put certain bookings on hold until we’ve completed our assessment. If we have concerns about serious misconduct, we may decide to cancel your upcoming bookings or to decline future bookings via the Platform.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eDuring calls with our customer service team, live listening might be carried out or calls might be recorded for quality assurance and training, handling of claims, and fraud detection purposes. If you do not wish for your call to be recorded, you may end the call.  Call recordings are kept for a limited amount of time and automatically deleted thereafter, unless Agoda has a legitimate interest to retain such recording for a longer period.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eTo respond to legal demands and other compliance matters:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWhere necessary or appropriate we may use your personal data to handle/resolve legal claims, respond to regulatory requests/demands or to ensure compliance with obligations conferred or imposed by law.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eAlgorithms and Artificial Intelligence (AI):\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eAs further described in our \u003ca href=\u0022https://www.agoda.com/info/termsofuse.html\u0022\u003eTerms of Use\u003c/a\u003e, we may deploy tools that utilize algorithms and AI to provide, improve and develop our services. These tools may make use of your information, including personal data, to help us deliver, personalize, and enhance your experience. This may include, for example, generating personalized content, promotions or recommendations, tailoring the customer experience and support to you, and identifying potentially suspicious transactions to help prevent fraudulent use of our services, identifying potentially suspicious transactions to help prevent fraudulent use of our services. Where we deploy such tools, we do so in accordance with applicable laws and with appropriate safeguards. In certain cases we may ask that you do not input personally identifiable information.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ca name=\u0022legal_basis_we_rely_on_to_process_your_personal_data\u0022\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e3. Legal basis we rely on to process your personal data\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWhere required by law, we rely on the following legal bases to process personal data.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eNecessity to Perform Contract with You (Article 15(1)(4) of the Personal Information Protection Act)\u003c/strong\u003e - we need to process your personal data in order to provide our Travel Product services to you, answer questions and requests from you, and provide customer support;\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eOur Legitimate Interests (Article 15(1)(6) of the Personal Information Protection Act)\u003c/strong\u003e - we process your personal data: (i) for security and safety; (ii) for account reconciliation and debt recovery purposes; (iii) to detect and prevent fraud; (iv) to protect and defend the rights or property of others, or our own rights and interests; (v) to analyze, improve, customize and provide our Travel Product booking and related services to you or communicate with you as necessary to provide you with the requested services;(vi) to maintain, operate and improve the Platform, including to keep it updated and relevant; (vii) to develop our business and to inform our marketing strategy; and (viii) to respond to domestic and foreign law enforcement requests, court orders, and legal process;\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eCompliance with Legal Obligations (Article 15(1)(2) of the Personal Information Protection Act)\u003c/strong\u003e - we need to process your personal data to comply with relevant laws and regulatory requirements;\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eConsent for sensitive personal data, uniquely identifying information, marketing communications and personalized content and advertising (Article 15(1)(1) of the Personal Information Protection Act)\u003c/strong\u003e- we rely on your consent for us to collect sensitive personal data and uniquely identifying information, send marketing communications  and provide you with tailored content and ads on this and other sites, apps or social media platforms based on your interactions on this and other sites or apps or social media platforms. You can withdraw your consent provided to us at any time by following the instructions set out in this Privacy Policy \u003ca href =\u0022#dsrr\u0022\u003e(see section “DSRR” and \u0022Cookies\u0022)\u003c/a\u003e; and\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eProtect Vital Interest (Article 15(1)(5) of the Personal Information Protection Act)\u003c/strong\u003e - we may need to process your personal data in case of emergency involving an individual\u0027s life or health.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ca name=\u0022who_do_we_share_data_with\u0022\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e4. Who do we share your personal data with?\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe may share your personal data with third parties in order to provide our Travel Product services to you, namely Travel Suppliers, service providers, business partners, or our affiliated group companies. \u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eTravel Suppliers:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eDepending on your Travel Product booking, we collaborate and share your personal data with various “Travel Suppliers”, which are primarily accommodation providers (e.g. third-party hotels, homes), other third-party accommodation platforms, airlines, activities providers, transportation services providers, eSIM providers or aggregators of such services to fulfill your booking.  These suppliers may collaborate with Agoda to offer travel services under their own brand while utilizing Agoda\u0027s technology and inventory.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe may also share your personal data (such as name, booking ID) with these Travel Suppliers (e.g. Booking.com) for reconciliation and commission-sharing purposes. These suppliers, acting as independent data controllers, may contact you as necessary to obtain additional information about you to facilitate your booking, including communicating with you prior to arrival about your upcoming stay, or responding to a review you may submit in accordance with their own independent privacy policies.  Please note that some Travel Suppliers might require us to share your personal data with a partnered connectivity service provider to facilitate the completion and management of your booking. These connectivity services providers operate on behalf of the Travel Suppliers to assist in handling their booking processes.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eService Providers:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eTo support us in providing our services we use third party service providers that may process your personal data for purposes such as payment processing business analytics, customer service, marketing, distribution of surveys, to facilitate the delivery of online services, insurance, security, IT infrastructure services and/or fraud prevention.  When a chargeback is requested for your reservation, we may need to share relevant booking details with payment providers and financial institutions to process or defend the chargeback. We may also share information with relevant financial institutions if we consider it necessary for fraud prevention, such as the use of stolen cards. We may also engage with service providers, such as advertising partners, for the delivery of content and advertising tailored to your interests with which we may share one-way hashed information about you. They may combine the hashed information with other identifiers to facilitate the delivery of business analytics on advertising effectiveness. As this may involve cookies (or similar technologies),\u0026nbsp; please also see \u003ca href = \u0022#cookies\u0022\u003eSection 5 Cookies\u003c/a\u003e. Our third-party service providers are required to only process information as needed to perform their functions.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eBusiness Partners:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe may share your personal data with business partners, acting as independent controllers, with whom we may integrate our Travel Products or services, or whose products or services may be offered on our Platforms. You can tell when a third-party business partner is involved in a product or service you have requested because their name will appear, either alone or with ours. Examples of business partners include  third-party loyalty program providers that you may earn points from when you make certain Travel Product bookings on our Platform, banks, other online travel agencies (OTAs) etc.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eAffiliated Group Companies:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe may share your personal data with our affiliated (group) companies: (i) who need to know and have access to this information with our permission to analyze how you use our independent and affiliated platforms, improve and provide new and personalized offers, products and services, and marketing; (ii) for the exchange of your personal data with Booking Holdings Group companies in order to detect, prevent, and investigate fraudulent transactions and/or activities, other illegal activities, and data breaches; (iii) for internal (audit/compliance) investigations; or (iv) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eLaw Enforcement Authorities \u0026amp; Legal Advisors (Where Required or Permitted by Law):\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe may share your personal data to protect ourselves against liability or to respond to subpoenas, judicial processes, legitimate requests, warrants or equivalent by law enforcement officials or authorities, to investigate fraud or other wrongdoing or as otherwise required or necessary in order to comply with applicable law, protect our legitimate interests or those of the purchasers in connection with any sale, assignment, or other transfer of all or a part of our business or company. We may also, in compliance with applicable law, disclose your personal data to enforce or apply the terms and conditions applicable to our services or to protect the rights, property, or safety of Agoda, our users, or others.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eAny other third party in case of Business Reorganization:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe may share your personal data as part of any sale, assignment or other transfer of our business, or transition of service to another provider.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eList of Third parties to whom we provide personal data\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ca name= \u0022thirdpartyvisit\u0022\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eThird party recipients when you visit our Platform\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eAgoda may, at the time-of- service such as when you visit our Platform, sign up to be our member, or contact our domestic representative via telephone, text or email, entrust your information to the third party  located in Korea and outside Korea (Article 28-8(1)(3) of the Personal Information Protection Act (entrustment and storage to the extent necessary for the performance of a contract)), via internet network or through other appropriate channels as set forth below. For details regarding cross-border transfers of personal data (e.g., legal basis, data items, transferred countries, timing and method, recipient information, purpose and retention period, and opt-out options), please refer to Section 4, \u0026ldquo;Who do we share your personal data with.\u0026rdquo; We maintain its confidentiality, ensure appropriate contractual, organizational and technical protections, and comply with the international data transfer requirements for cross-border transfers as described in this Privacy Statement and as required by applicable law.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWhere required, we may rely on your consent, the Standard Contractual Clauses and/or the need to process your personal data, in order to provide the requested services (performance of a contract) to transfer your personal data.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eAs permitted by applicable law, you may request details about the suitable safeguards we have in place by contacting us as detailed in the \u003ca href= \u0022#contact_us\u0022\u003e“contact us\u0022 section\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ca name=\u0022how_do_we_protect_your_personal_data\u0022\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e7. How do we protect your personal data?\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe maintain reasonable physical, technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal data against accidental or unlawful destruction or accidental loss, alteration, or unauthorized disclosure or access.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003ePayment Data Security\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe adhere to industry best practices and standards (PCI-DSS) to protect your payment data such as encryption, stringent access control, etc.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eProtection of your personal data by a Third Party\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThird parties we share your personal data with in order to provide our Travel Product services to you are contractually obligated to keep your data secure and confidential.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eAccount Security\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eConsistent with this policy and our \u003ca href=\u0022/info/termsofuse.html\u0022\u003eTerms of Use\u003c/a\u003e, you are responsible for the data and content you submit to us and how you use your Agoda Account, including taking reasonable measures to make your account secure. For added protection, we strongly recommend that you set up two-factor authentication for your Agoda Account. This adds an extra authentication step, to help ensure that anyone who gets hold of your username and password (e.g., through phishing or other similar techniques) won’t be able to get into your account. You can set this up via your account settings.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ca name=\u0022how_long_do_we_retain_your_personal_data\u0022\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e8. How long do we retain your personal data?\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe will retain your personal data, including sensitive personal data, for as long as necessary to facilitate your bookings and related requests  to communicate with you, provide, administer and secure our Platform and services, and to exercise our legal rights, protect our or other’s interests, and comply with our legal or regulatory obligations.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWhen we no longer need to keep your personal data, we will remove it from our IT systems and records where feasible, and/or deactivate it or take other reasonable steps to depersonalize it so that you can no longer be identified from it. You can always log into your personal Agoda account to delete, edit, or add your personal data including certain payment details. For security reasons, the credit card number cannot be edited (but the card details can be deleted). Please note that we will store the last 4 digits of your credit card securely upon any booking made (this is required to manage any refund requests for that booking).\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ca name=\u0022dsrr\u0022\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e9. Your rights pertaining to the personal data we collect about you (DSRR)\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eYou can easily correct your personal data related to your account (subject to the cancellation policy attached to the booking), to the extent such rights are granted to you under applicable laws and regulations: at any time by signing in to your account on the website.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eYou can opt out of receiving marketing communications from us at any time by using the \u0026ldquo;Unsubscribe\u0026rdquo; link or opt out mechanism in our marketing communication channels or through your Agoda account (depending on the channel you are trying to opt-out from).\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIn addition to the above, please contact us via our \u003ca href = \u0022http://www.agoda.com/info/contact_agoda.html\u0022\u003eCustomer Support page\u003c/a\u003e or at \u003ca href = \u0022mailto:privacy@agoda.com\u0022\u003eprivacy@agoda.com\u003c/a\u003e to exercise any of the rights in bullet points below. Please note that to protect your privacy and security, we will verify your identity before responding to such request, and your request will be answered within a reasonable timeframe.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003e\u003cb\u003eAccess:\u003c/b\u003e You are entitled at any time to obtain information about your personal data that we store, in accordance with applicable law and without any fee.
