In such case we may collect, store, process and disclose the personal data we have on you together with such other additional data elements including, but not limited to your national identification document, visa application, nationality, or date of birth as may be necessary to comply with the requirements set by the relevant government agencies for the specific programs. Please do not participate in the respective programs or promotions if you do not want your data to be processed by Agoda and, if applicable,\u0026nbsp;disclosed to the relevant government agencies or their representatives for such purposes.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eSensitive Personal Data:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eCertain types of personal data, such as religion, health related data or children’s data, are considered sensitive and may require additional protection under applicable laws. Although we do not ordinarily collect sensitive personal data as part of our standard Travel Product bookings, there may be a need , from time to time, to collect such information e.g. as contained in a government-issued identification document or medical certificate (e.g. if such information is supportive of a transaction or request that you ask us to perform on your behalf such as a cancellation or amendment of your booking, as part of legal requirements (e.g.\u0026nbsp;accessibility or other special travel preferences) or if you may choose to share such information voluntarily through any contact you may have with Agoda. You may also elect to provide us with other information which may imply or suggest information like religion, health or other information, such as when specifying your dietary needs.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eUnless requested by our customer service team, we discourage you from providing sensitive personal data (yours or of other guest or third parties) on any of our customer support channels. This extends to any other communication channels we may make available (e.g. email, phone, in-app or platform messages, chatbots, Agoda\u0027s AI powered travel assistant, or other trip planning or saving features, social media messaging apps).\u0026nbsp;If you choose to disclose this data, we will treat this as you having given your explicit consent for\u0026nbsp;use of that information as described in this Privacy Policy.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eChildren\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eOur Platform is not directed towards children or people under the legal age of majority where our Platform is accessed.  If parents or guardians provide us with information about children, we may collect it to facilitate a Travel Product booking, provide related services or for other exceptional circumstances (such as features addressed to families). This will only be used and collected as provided by the parent or guardian.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIf you are a parent or guardian and believe we may have  collected personal data from a minor other than as contemplated above, please notify us to request that we  remove that personal data.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e\u003cu\u003eInformation we may collect from third parties\u003c/u\u003e\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThese can include Travel Suppliers, affiliated group companies, service providers and other independent third parties. Information we receive from these third parties may be used together with other information about you.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eFor example, Travel Suppliers or business partners may share certain information about you with us, such as your name and email address, your address, payment details and other relevant information to facilitate your Travel Product booking (including questions or any related disputes) and to identify the channel from which your reservation originated.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIf you access or sign in to our Platform through social media service providers, such as Meta (Facebook, WhatsApp), Google, Kakao, etc. we may receive information about you such as your username and other information you may make available to us via such services.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe also integrate with payment services providers to facilitate payments between you and Travel Suppliers. They may share payment information so we can facilitate your Travel Product booking.\u0026nbsp;If you are an eligible user of our Platform and have signed up for an AgodaWallet, we may receive limited information from Booking Holdings Financial Services UK Limited (“BHFS UK”) relating to your use of the AgodaWallet.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe may also receive information such as additional cookie data, which our service providers, such as advertising partners, may make available to us.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIn some cases, we may provide links to other websites or mobile apps that are not owned or operated by us (\u0022Third-Party Websites\u0022). When you click on these Third-Party Websites, such third parties may share certain personal data related to you or your interactions on these Third-Party Websites with us in accordance with their privacy policies. You will be subject to that  Third-Party Websites’ privacy and security practices, which may differ from ours.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe encourage you to carefully review the privacy and cookie policies of any Third-Party Websites you use to understand how your personal data is managed and shared by them, and what controls you might have over your data with such third parties.  We have no control over, and are not responsible for, the content, services, or privacy and security practices of any Third-Party Websites.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ca name=\u0022how_do_we_use_your_personal_data\u0022\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e2. How do we use your personal data?\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe use your information for several purposes.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eTo facilitate a Travel Product booking and related requests:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe may use your personal data to provide you with the requested services, such as creating a user account with us, facilitate the creation of user accounts with our affiliated group companies or Travel Suppliers as may be authorized by you, processing and confirming your booking, facilitating payments between you and Travel Suppliers, planning, saving your Travel Bookings or plans,\u0026nbsp;and communicating with you about services requested such as pre-booking or post- booking customer support, to deal with special requests, responding to any questions you may have, helping you to contact the right Travel Supplier or business partner for amendments, cancellations, and rewards.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eTo communicate with you:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe may get in touch with you through email, text, phone call, social media channels or through push notifications after you book with us on our Platform to confirm your booking, to remind you of your upcoming bookings and payments or to inform you of important messages or instructions relating to your bookings.  To manage Cashback Rewards, we may send you notifications to inform you of your eligibility, reward balance and to remind you of upcoming expiry dates. These are part of your booking process and are not marketing messages. You will continue to receive them, even if you have opted out of our marketing messages. If you are making a booking for another person, you also have the option to insert the guest’s email address for the purpose of the guest receiving the booking confirmation.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eSimilarly, opting into receiving Price Alerts will not affect any other choices you have made regarding receiving communications from us. If you elect to receive Price Alerts, you will be able to opt out of receiving the same by clicking on the “turn off price alerts” or a similar message found in the Price Alert sent to you.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIf you have not finalized a booking online, we may send you up to two reminders to continue with your booking. We believe that this additional service is useful to you because it allows you to carry on with a booking without having to search for the booking again or fill in all the booking details from scratch. Booking information used for such reminders will be deleted from our systems in accordance with our data retention policy detailed below.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cem\u003eTo enable your use of Agoda\u0027s AI powered travel assistant\u003c/em\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eAs further described in \u003ca href=\u0022https://www.agoda.com/info/ai-assistant-terms-of-use.html\u0022\u003eAgoda\u0027s AI powered travel assistant Terms of Use\u003c/a\u003e, our AI powered travel assistant\u0026nbsp;can be used to explore travel options and plan your travel including identifying available Travel Products available from Travel Suppliers on the  Platform and make suggestions for your itinerary. It allows you to start a separate chat for each trip you wish to plan (\u0022\u003cstrong\u003eConversation Thread\u003c/strong\u003e\u0022). If you use Agoda\u0027s AI powered travel assistant, it will collect data you input or link through a Conversation Thread and retain and build upon that data throughout the Conversation Thread. Agoda\u0027s AI powered travel assistant uses third party hosted products including large language model tools to process this data together with other data about your past booking details to build a profile about your travel preferences that is applied in responding to you in that Conversation Thread. Do not input any sensitive data, such as credit card details, and we strongly urge you to limit the data you input to what is strictly necessary.\u003c/p\u003e\n  \u003cp\u003eWe may review Conversation Threads as part of monitoring the performance of our AI powered travel assistant, (e.g. for quality assurance purposes) and making improvements.\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eTo send you marketing communication or provide you with tailored advertisements or suggestions:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe use your personal data to send you marketing communications about products, services, news, offers, promotion or surveys that may be relevant to you.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eSubject to your choices, the marketing channels we may use to communicate with you include email, SMS, mobile messaging apps (e.g., WhatsApp, Line, Messenger, KakaoTalk), push notifications when you have installed the Agoda app on your device and interest-based advertising,  tailored content and ads, delivered through our Platform and Third-Party Websites, apps or social media platforms based on your interactions on this and other sites or apps or social media platforms. The marketing channels we use to communicate with you will depend on your choices, such as the communication platforms you use, if you have opted to join an Agoda group on that channel, and the settings you have in place for the channel. Our ability to communicate with you through one of these marketing channels may also depend on the settings you have in place for the channel.  Please read the instructions of the specific channel or your mobile device to understand how to change the settings and enable the sharing of such information. For instance, you may change the setting of your mobile device to opt out of receiving push notifications (including Software Development Kit (\u0022SDK\u0022) and push token data). Different device operating systems may have varying default settings, so it is important to familiarize yourself with these settings governing e.g. push notifications.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eYou can withdraw your consent from receiving marketing communications from us at any time by using the \u0022Unsubscribe\u0022 link, through your device settings, your Agoda account (depending on the channel you are trying to withdraw your consent from)  or other withdrawal mechanisms provided for in the relevant marketing communication channels.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWhere required by law and subject to your choices, we may also show you personalized advertisements on our Platform, including promotions, travel options or suggestions, surveys, or any other updates about our Travel Products, based on what we think you may find interesting.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eTo maintain, operate and improve our Platform:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe may use your personal data to maintain and improve your user experience and our  Platform, to keep it updated and relevant, and to ensure compliance with the Agoda Platform Terms of Use. We may generate statistics about our business for these purposes and also to conduct internal training or to inform our marketing strategy, provide you with tailored content based on your interactions, both here and on other websites, apps, and social platforms.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eTo provide you with communication channels:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe may offer you and certain Travel Suppliers various channels to communicate with each other about your booking(s) via our Platform.  We may access communications on any channels we make available and may use automated systems to review, scan, and analyze communications for security purposes; fraud prevention; compliance with legal and regulatory requirements; investigations of potential misconduct; product development and improvement; research; customer engagement, including to provide you with information and offers that we believe may be of interest to you; and customer or technical support.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe reserve the right to block the delivery of or review communications on the channel that we, in our sole discretion, believe may contain malicious content, spam, or may pose a risk to you or to Travel Suppliers, us, or others. All communications sent or received using a Platform supplied communication channel will be received and stored by us.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eNote that, business partners, through whose platform you made a booking and Travel Suppliers may choose to communicate with you directly via email or other channels that are beyond our control.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cem\u003eTo provide you a safe and trustworthy service:\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe use personal data for risk assessment and security purposes, including for the purposes of detecting and preventing fraud and harm when you report a safety concern, for the authentication of users and reservations, or when others report a fraud or safety incident about you. When we do this, we may have to stop or put certain bookings on hold until we’ve completed our assessment. If we have concerns about serious misconduct, we may decide to cancel your upcoming reservations or to decline future reservations via the Platform.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eDuring calls with our customer service team, live listening might be carried out or calls might be recorded for quality assurance and training, handling of claims, and fraud detection purposes. If you do not wish for your call to be recorded, you may end the call.  Call recordings are kept for a limited amount of time and automatically deleted thereafter, unless Agoda has a legitimate interest to retain such recording for a longer period.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eTo respond to legal demands and other compliance matters:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWhere necessary or appropriate we may use your personal data to handle/resolve legal claims, respond to regulatory requests/demands or to ensure compliance with obligations conferred or imposed by law.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eAlgorithms and Artificial Intelligence (AI):\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eAs further described in our \u003ca href=\u0022/info/termsofuse.html\u0022\u003eTerms of Use\u003c/a\u003e, we may deploy tools that utilize algorithms and AI to provide, improve, and develop our services. These tools may make use of your information, including personal data, to help us deliver, personalize, and enhance your experience. This may include, for example, generating personalized content, promotions or recommendations, tailoring the customer experience and support to you, and identifying potentially suspicious transactions to help prevent fraudulent use of our services.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWhere we deploy such tools, we do so in accordance with applicable laws and with appropriate safeguards. In certain cases we may ask that you do not input personally identifiable information.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ca name=\u0022legal_basis_we_rely_on_to_process_your_personal_data\u0022\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e3. Legal basis we rely on to process your personal data\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWhere required by law, we rely on the following legal bases to process personal data:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eNecessity to Perform Contract with You\u003c/strong\u003e - we need to process your personal data in order to provide our Travel Product services to you, answer questions and requests from you, and provide customer support;\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eOur Legitimate Interests\u003c/strong\u003e - we process your personal data: (i) for security and safety; (ii) account reconciliation and debt recovery purposes; (iii) to detect and prevent fraud; (iv) to protect and defend the rights or property of others, or our own rights and interests; (v) to analyze, improve, customize and provide our Travel Product booking and related services to you or communicate with you as necessary to provide you with the requested services; (vi) to maintain, operate and improve the Platform, including to keep it updated and relevant, (vii) to develop our business and to inform our marketing strategy and (viii) to respond to domestic and foreign law enforcement requests, court orders, and legal process;\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eCompliance with Legal Obligations\u003c/strong\u003e - we need to process your personal data to comply with relevant laws and regulatory requirements;\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eConsent\u003c/strong\u003e - we rely on your consent for us to collect sensitive personal data and send marketing communications  and provide you with tailored content and ads on this and other sites, apps or social media platforms based on your interactions on this and other sites or apps or social media platforms. You can withdraw your consent provided to us at any time by following the instructions set out in this Privacy Policy (see also \u003ca href=\u0022#dsrr\u0022\u003e\u0022Section 9. Your rights pertaining to the personal data we collect about you (DSRR)” and \u0022Section 5 Cookies (Your Choices)\u0022, both below )\u003c/a\u003e; and\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eProtect Vital Interest\u003c/strong\u003e - we may need to process your personal data in case of emergency involving an individual\u0027s life or health.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ca name=\u0022who_do_we_share_data_with\u0022\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e4. Who do we share your personal data with?\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe may share your personal data with third parties in order to provide our Travel Product services to you, namely Travel Suppliers, service providers, business partners, or our affiliated group companies.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eTravel Suppliers:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eDepending on your Travel Product booking, we collaborate and share your personal data with various Travel Suppliers, which are primarily accommodation providers (e.g. third party hotels, homes), other third-party accommodation platforms, airlines, activities providers, transportation services providers, eSIM providers or aggregators of such services to fulfill your booking.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe may also share your personal data (such as name, booking ID) with these Travel Suppliers (e.g. Booking.com) for reconciliation and commission-sharing purposes. These suppliers, acting as independent data controllers, may contact you as necessary to obtain additional information about you to facilitate your booking, including communicating with you prior to arrival about your upcoming stay, or responding to a review you may submit in accordance with their own independent privacy policies.  Please note that some Travel Suppliers might require us to share your personal data with a partnered connectivity service provider to facilitate the completion and management of your booking. These connectivity services providers operate on behalf of the Travel Suppliers to assist in handling their reservation processes.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eService Providers:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eTo support us in providing our services we use third party service providers that may process your personal data for purposes such as payment processing, business analytics, customer service, marketing, distribution of surveys, to facilitate the delivery of online services, insurance, security, IT infrastructure services and/or fraud prevention. Some third party service providers (e.g. payment service providers such as \u003ca href=\u0022https://wise.com/gb/legal/privacy-notice-personal-en\u0022\u003eWise\u003c/a\u003e and \u003ca href=\u0022https://www.adyen.com/privacy-policy\u0022\u003eAdyen\u003c/a\u003e) may process your personal data as data controllers under their own privacy notices, for purposes such as to meet their legal or regulatory obligations, or support and improve the delivery of their services to us.\u003c/p\u003e \n\u003cp\u003eWhen a chargeback is requested for your reservation, we may need to share relevant booking details with payment providers and financial institutions to process or defend the chargeback. We may also share information with relevant financial institutions if we consider it necessary for fraud prevention, such as the use of stolen cards.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe may also engage with service providers, such as advertising partners, for the delivery of content and advertising tailored to your interests with which we may share one-way hashed information about you. They may combine the hashed information with other identifiers to facilitate the delivery of business analytics on advertising effectiveness. As this may involve cookies (or similar technologies) please also check \u0022 \u003ca href=\u0022#cookies\u0022\u003eSection 5. Cookies\u0022.\u003c/a\u003eOur third-party service providers are required to only process information as needed to perform their functions.\u003c/p\u003e  \n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eBusiness Partners:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe may share your personal data with business partners, acting as independent controllers, with whom we may integrate our Travel Products or services, or whose products or services may be offered on our Platform. You can tell when a third-party business partner is involved in a product or service you have requested because their name will appear, either alone or with ours. Examples of business partners include third-party loyalty program providers that you may earn points from when you make certain Travel Product bookings on our Platform, banks, other online travel agencies (OTAs) etc.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eAffiliated Group Companies:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe may share your personal data with our affiliated (group) companies who need to know and have access to this information with our permission to analyze how you use our independent and affiliated platforms, improve and provide new and personalized offers, products and services, and marketing; the exchange of your personal data with Booking Holdings Group companies in order to detect, prevent, and investigate fraudulent transactions and/or activities, other illegal activities, and data breaches; internal (audit/compliance) investigations; where these affiliated (group) companies may offer products or services on our Platform including but not limited to the AgodaWallet offering by BHFS UK; or as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eLaw Enforcement Authorities \u0026 Legal Advisors (Where Required or Permitted by Law):\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe may share your personal data to protect ourselves against liability or, to respond to subpoenas, judicial processes, legitimate requests, warrants or equivalent by law enforcement officials or authorities, to investigate fraud or other wrongdoing or as otherwise required or necessary in order to comply with applicable law, protect our legitimate interests or those of the purchasers in connection with any sale, assignment, or other transfer of all or a part of our business or company. We may also, in compliance with applicable law, disclose your personal data to enforce or apply the terms and conditions applicable to our services or to protect the rights, property, or safety of Agoda, our users, or others.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eAny other third party in case of Business Reorganization:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe may share your personal data as\u0026nbsp;part of any sale, assignment or other transfer of our business, or transition of service to another provider.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ca name=\u0022cookies\u0022\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e5.Cookies\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eOur Platform may use and allow third parties to place cookies (session and persistent), pixels/tags, software development kits (usually referred to as SDKs), application program interfaces (\u0026ldquo;APIs\u0026rdquo;), and other tracking technologies (collectively, \u0026ldquo;Cookies\u0026rdquo;) on our Platform that may collect and store certain information about you. \u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cu\u003eWhat Cookies do we use?\u003c/u\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eYou can find more information about the types of Cookies we use and the purposes for which we use them in the table below:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ctable\u003e\n  \u003ctr\u003e\n    \u003cth\u003eType of cookie\u003c/th\u003e\n    \u003cth\u003ePurpose\u003c/th\u003e\n    \u003cth\u003eDuration until expiry\u003c/th\u003e\n  \u003c/tr\u003e\n  \u003ctr\u003e\n    \u003ctd\u003eFunctional Cookies\u003c/td\u003e\n\t\u003ctd\u003eThese cookies are set to provide the service, application, or resource requested. Without these cookies, your request cannot be delivered appropriately, and our website may not function as expected or in a secure way. These trackers are set to manage essential actions, such as requesting website visual elements, page resources, or due user login/logoff. We can also use these cookies to set up essential functionalities to guarantee the security and efficiency of the service requested, like authentication and load balancer requests.\u003c/td\u003e\n\t\u003ctd\u003eUp to 2 years\u003c/td\u003e\n  \u003c/tr\u003e\n  \u003ctr\u003e\n\t\u003ctd\u003eTargeting Cookies\u003c/td\u003e\n\t\u003ctd\u003eWe and our advertising partners set these cookies to provide tailored content and ads, interest-based advertising and perform analytics. They may be used to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant content and ads on this or other sites/apps. They may not store directly personal information but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.\u003c/td\u003e\n\t\u003ctd\u003eUp to 2 years\u003c/td\u003e\n  \u003c/tr\u003e\n  \u003ctr\u003e\n\t\u003ctd\u003eSocial media Cookies\u003c/td\u003e\n\t\u003ctd\u003eThese Cookies are used when you share information using a social media sharing button or \u0022like\u0022 button on our Platform, or when you engage with our content on or through a social site such as Facebook or X (formerly known as Twitter). These Cookies collect information about your social media interaction with social media sites, such as whether or not you have an account with the social media site and whether you are logged into it when you interact with content on their sites. This information may be linked to targeting/advertising activities.\u003c/td\u003e\n\t\u003ctd\u003eUp to 2 years\u003c/td\u003e\n  \u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/table\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eThird Parties:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eYour use of the Platform may result in some Cookies being stored that are not controlled by us. This may occur when the part of the Platform you are visiting makes use of a third-party analytics or marketing automation/management tool or includes content displayed from a Third-Party Website. You should review the privacy and Cookie policies of these services to find out how these third parties use Cookies and whether your Cookie data will be transferred to a third country.  The list of third parties who place Cookies on our Platform is available in our cookie banner (see also more in\u0026nbsp;\u003ca href=\u0022#who_do_we_share_data_with\u0022\u003e \u0022Section 4. Who do we share your personal data with?”)\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eInterest Based Advertising:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe may allow certain third parties to place Cookies on our Platform to collect information about your online activities on our Platform (e.g., pages visited on the Platform and searches you performed) across different websites you visited. This information is used to provide advertising tailored to your interests from us (via email, on our Platform, and on other websites) and by third parties on other websites you may visit, also known as interest-based advertising and to analyze the effectiveness of such interest-based advertising. We may also share one-way hashed information with third party partners (e.g., Meta, Google), who may combine hashed information with other identifiers in order to serve custom Agoda advertisements on other websites or mobile apps based on your prior visits to the Platform or to facilitate the delivery of business analytics on advertising effectiveness. Agoda neither supports nor endorses the goals, causes, or statements of any websites or mobile apps that display our advertisements.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eCross-Device Tracking:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe may also combine information collected through Cookies and certain usage information from a particular browser or mobile device with another computer or device that may be linked to you (cross-device tracking) to optimize our services and provide tailored Agoda communications and advertisements to you. If you do not wish to receive such tailored communications from us, please unsubscribe from the specific Agoda communications channels and/or adjust your mobile device or desktop setting.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eLocal Storage:\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIn addition to Cookies, our Platform uses local storage technologies like HTML5 local storage, session storage, and similar technologies to enhance your experience. Local storage allows us to store information directly on your device without expiration until explicitly deleted, whereas session storage is deleted automatically once the browsing session ends or when the app is closed. This data helps us remember your preferences, optimize performance, and provide enhanced functionalities.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eYou have full control over the data stored in local storage. To review or adjust your Cookie preferences, please follow the instructions shown in the cookie banner, your account settings or your browser.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003ePlease review your Internet browser settings, typically under the sections \u0026ldquo;Help\u0026rdquo; or \u0026ldquo;Internet Options,\u0026rdquo; to exercise choices you have for certain Cookies. Cross border transfer of your data\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe implement appropriate safeguards for cross-border data transfers as required by applicable laws.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eAgoda is a global business. In connection with “How we use your personal data” as described above, your personal data may be transferred, stored and maintained at locations outside of your home country which may not have the same data protection laws. We maintain its confidentiality, ensure appropriate\u0026nbsp;contractual, organizational and technical protections, and comply with the relevant international data transfer requirements as\u0026nbsp;described in this Privacy Policy and as  required by applicable law.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWhere required, we may rely on your consent, prescribed model clauses or standard contractual clauses and/or the need to process your personal data in order to provide the requested services (performance of a contract), to transfer your personal data.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eAs permitted by applicable law, you may request details about the safeguards we have in place by contacting us as detailed in \u003ca href=\u0022#contact_us\u0022\u003e\u0026ldquo;Section 11. Who is responsible for the processing of your personal data and how to contact us?\u0026rdquo; below.\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ca name=\u0022how_do_we_protect_your_personal_data\u0022\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e7. How do we protect your personal data?\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe maintain reasonable physical, technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal data against accidental or unlawful destruction or accidental loss, alteration, or unauthorized disclosure or access.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003ePayment Data Security\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe adhere to industry best practices and standards (PCI-DSS) to protect your payment data such as encryption, stringent access control, etc.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eProtection of your personal data by a Third Party\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThird party  we share your personal data with in order to provide our Travel Product services to you are contractually obligated to keep your data secure and confidential.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eAccount Security\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eConsistent with this policy and our \u003ca href=\u0022/info/termsofuse.html\u0022\u003eTerms of Use\u003c/a\u003e, you are responsible for the data and content you submit to us and how you use your Agoda Account, including taking reasonable measures to make your account secure. For added protection, we strongly recommend that you set up two-factor authentication for your Agoda Account. This adds an extra authentication step, to help ensure that anyone who gets hold of your username and password (e.g., through phishing or other similar techniques) won’t be able to get into your account. You can set this up via your account settings.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ca name=\u0022how_long_do_we_retain_your_personal_data\u0022\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e8. How long do we retain your personal data?\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe will retain your personal data, including sensitive personal data, for as long as necessary to facilitate your bookings and related requests, to communicate with you, provide, administer and secure our Platform and services, to exercise our legal rights, to resolve disputes and legal claims, protect our or other’s interests, and comply with our legal or regulatory obligations.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWhen we no longer need to keep your personal data, we will remove it from our IT systems and records where feasible, and/or deactivate it and/or take other reasonable steps  so that you can no longer be identified from the data. You can always log into your personal Agoda account to delete, edit, or add your personal data including certain payment details. For security reasons, the credit card\u0026nbsp;number cannot be edited (but the card details can be deleted).\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003ePlease note that we will store the last 4 digits of your credit card securely upon any booking made (this is required to manage any refund requests for that booking).\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ca name=\u0022dsrr\u0022\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e9. Your rights pertaining to the personal data we collect about you (DSRR)\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eYou can easily correct your personal data related to your account (subject to the cancellation policy attached to the booking) at any time by signing in to your account on the website.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eYou can opt out of receiving marketing communications from us at any time by using the \u0026ldquo;Unsubscribe\u0026rdquo; link or opt out mechanism in our marketing communication channels or through your Agoda account (depending on the channel you are trying to opt-out from).\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eAlternatively, please contact us via our \u003ca href=\u0022https://www.agoda.com/info/contact.html?asq=%2BgjATXCOYWsyt2fxmtYmSM9ssPMWx4G%2F9wRRoLH4Rsk%3D\u0022\u003eCustomer Support page\u003c/a\u003e or at \u003ca href=\u0022privacy@agoda.com\u0022\u003eprivacy@agoda.com\u003c/a\u003e to exercise any of the rights in bullet points below, to the extent such rights are granted to you under applicable laws and regulations.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003ePlease note that to protect your privacy and security, we will verify your identity before responding to such request, and your request will be answered within a reasonable timeframe.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eAccess:\u003c/strong\u003e You may be entitled at any time to obtain information about your personal data that we store, in accordance with applicable law and without any fee. However, in exceptional cases and where so permitted by applicable law, we may ask you to pay reasonable fees before we provide the information.\u0026nbsp;We may not be able to allow you to access certain personal data in some cases e.g. if your personal data is connected with personal data of other persons, or for legal reasons. In such cases, we will provide you with an explanation why you cannot obtain this information.\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eRectification:\u003c/strong\u003e You may request that we rectify any of your personal data that is incomplete or incorrect.\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eDeletion:\u003c/strong\u003e You may request that we delete your personal data. Please note, we may not be able to honour your request for deletion or rectification of your personal data if you have future/ongoing service with us or due to legal requirements, especially those affecting our accounting processes, processing or defence of claims, for fraud detection or prevention purposes, and mandatory data retention, which may prohibit deletion or anonymization.\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eRestrictions of Processing:\u003c/strong\u003e : You may ask us to cease processing of your personal data, for example if you have objected to the processing and the existence of legitimate grounds are still under consideration.\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eObjection:\u003c/strong\u003e You may object, at any time, to your personal data being processed for direct marketing purposes. You may also opt out of receiving marketing communications from us at any time by using the \u0026ldquo;Unsubscribe\u0026rdquo; link or opt-out mechanism in our marketing communication channels or through your Agoda account (depending on the channel you are trying to opt-out from).\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eRight to Revoke Consent:\u003c/strong\u003e Where processing of your personal data is based on your consent, you have the right to withdraw your consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of our processing based on such consent before it was withdrawn.\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eData Portability:\u003c/strong\u003e If under law there is an applicable data portability requirement, you may request us to send you your personal data which we store, in a commonly used and machine-readable format (which shall be decided at our sole discretion).\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eRight to opt-out of profiling/ automated decision making:\u003c/strong\u003e You may have the right to opt out of processing of your personal data for purposes of profiling or automated decision making that produce legal or significant effects on your freedom.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe may not be able to allow you to access certain personal data in some cases e.g. if your personal data is connected with personal data of other persons, or for legal reasons. In such cases, we will provide you with an explanation why you cannot obtain this information. We may also deny your request for deletion or rectification of your personal data if you have future/ongoing services with us or due to legal requirements, especially those affecting our accounting processes, processing or the defence of claims, for fraud detection or prevention purposes, and mandatory data retention, which may prohibit deletion or anonymization. This includes retaining your personal data for a period of 120 days after your last checkout to handle any post-booking matters such as in the case of complaints or claims, for fraud prevention, trade sanction reasons, legal claims or requests.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eFor other country specific rights please see \u003ca href=\u0022#country_specific_provisions\u0022\u003e“Country-Specific Provisions ” section\u003c/a\u003e below.\u0026nbsp;These prevail over the above to the extent of any inconsistency.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIn some cases, the law may prevent us from complying with your request or allow us to refuse your request.\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ca name=\u0022about_this_privacy_policy\u0022\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e10. Country-specific provisions\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eDepending on the jurisdiction applicable to you, we may be obligated to furnish additional data. If relevant, you will find specific details pertaining to your country or region outlined below.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e\u003cu\u003eUnited States\u003c/u\u003e\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003eUS Residents (non-California):\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWe collect, use, and disclose Personal Data as described in the other sections of this Privacy Policy.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eDepending on the state where you reside, you may have specific rights under local state legislation to:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003erequest access (right to know) to your Personal Data, such as the Personal Data that we have collected about you;\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003erequest rectification (correction) of your Personal Data;\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003erequest erasure (deletion) of your Personal Data;\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003erequest restriction of processing of your Personal Data;\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003erequest data portability (port your Personal Data);\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003eopt out of certain sales, sharing and targeted advertising;\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003eobject to the processing of your Personal Data, including opting out of automated decision-making, including profiling, with significant legal effect;\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003erequest the Personal Data about you that we have \u0026ldquo;sold\u0026rdquo;(as such term is defined under applicable law), shared, or disclosed for a business purpose within the past 12 months; and\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003eappeal a decision to decline a request.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003cp\u003ePlease contact us on our \u003ca href=\u0022/info/contact.html\u0022\u003eCustomer Support page\u003c/a\u003e or at \u003ca href=\u0022mailto:privacy@agoda.com\u0022\u003eprivacy@agoda.com\u003c/a\u003e to exercise such rights. In any event, should you choose to exercise any of your rights as detailed above, we will not discriminate against you based solely on your request.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIn certain jurisdictions, if we refuse to act on a request, you may appeal our decision within a reasonable period of time by contacting us as outlined below in the \u003ca href=\u0022#contact_us\u0022\u003e\u0026ldquo;Who is responsible for the processing of your personal data and how to contact us?\u0026rdquo; section\u003c/a\u003e and specify your wish to appeal. We have included this California-specific information below.\u003c/p\u003e \n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eCA Personal Data\u003c/strong\u003e. Consistent with the \u003ca href=\u0022#what_personal_data_do_we_collect_about_you\u0022\u003e\u0026ldquo;What personal data do we collect about you?\u0026rdquo; section\u003c/a\u003e of this privacy policy, we may collect and process certain categories of personal data about California residents (“CA Personal Data”), such as:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul\u003e\n  \u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eIdentifiers:\u003c/strong\u003e name, location, phone number, e-mail address, passport details, Agoda account password, IP address, device ID, cookie ID, information collected via Cookies;\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eCommercial Information:\u003c/strong\u003e payment card details, name of and details about your accommodation, services purchased, search preferences, transaction history, demographic information;\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eInternet or Other Electronic Network Activity:\u003c/strong\u003e browser, operating system, application version, pages shown;\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eGeolocation Data:\u003c/strong\u003e you may grant us access to your location information in order to provide services requested by you;\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eAudio Information:\u003c/strong\u003e we may record your calls to our support team with your permission;\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eInferences:\u003c/strong\u003e  drawn from the information collected; and\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eOther Information:\u003c/strong\u003e information associated with a tour or activity booking, including your passport details, date of birth, height and weight, pick-up location, your preferred tour/activity language, and information about any special requirements that we need to consider in connection with your participation in the respective tour/activity.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eCA Sensitive Personal Data.\u003c/strong\u003e Certain CA Personal Data that we collect about you may be considered sensitive personal data within the meaning of California Privacy Law, including: passport details (for transactional purposes), payment card information (for billing and transactional purposes in connection with Travel Products or other ancillary services purchased), and precise geolocation information (for providing services). Agoda only uses and discloses sensitive personal data as necessary in connection with the performance of services and the provision of goods, compliance with federal, state, or local laws, and as otherwise permitted by California Privacy Law.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eSources of CA Personal Data.\u003c/strong\u003e Consistent with the \u003ca href=\u0022#what_personal_data_do_we_collect_about_you\u0022\u003e\u0026ldquo;What personal data do we collect about you?\u0026rdquo; section\u003c/a\u003e of this privacy policy, we may collect personal data directly from you, as well as from Travel Suppliers, Accommodation Partners, business partners (including social media), and our affiliated group companies.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eUse of CA Personal Data\u003c/strong\u003e. We process your personal data for the business and commercial purposes consistent with the the \u003ca href=\u0022#what_personal_data_do_we_collect_about_you\u0022\u003e“What personal data do we collect about you?” section\u003c/a\u003e above.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eDisclosure of CA Personal Data for Business Purposes.\u003c/strong\u003e We disclose the following categories of personal data for business purposes: Identifiers, Commercial Information, Internet or Other Electronic Network Activity, Geolocation Data, Audio Information, and Other Information to web hosting, payment card and payment processing, business analytics, customer service, and business partners.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eSelling or Sharing of  CA Personal Data.\u003c/strong\u003e We may disclose the following categories of personal data for commercial purposes: Identifiers, specifically, preferences and interests on our Platform, collected via Cookies to advertising technology providers and, in limited instances, email addresses in hashed format, to social media companies, marketing, and survey service providers. These are sharing activities that are considered a sale under California Privacy Law.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eRetention of CA Personal Data.\u003c/strong\u003e We retain your personal data consistent with the \u003ca href=\u0022#how_long_do_we_retain_your_personal_data\u0022\u003e\u0026ldquo;How long do we retain your personal data\u0026rdquo; section\u003c/a\u003e .\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eYour Rights under California Privacy Law:\u003c/strong\u003eSubject to certain exceptions detailed in California Privacy Law and other applicable laws and regulations, as a California resident you have the right to:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003eRequest to know/access/rectify your CA Personal Data, including the specific pieces and the categories of CA Personal Data we have collected or shared about you and the categories of sources from which we have collected the CA Personal Data;\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003eRequest deletion of your CA Personal Data;\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003eReceive information about the CA Personal Data about you that we have \u0026ldquo;sold\u0026rdquo; to (as such term is defined under California Privacy Law) or \u0026ldquo;shared\u0026rdquo; with third parties within the past 12 months, including the categories of third parties;\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003eLimit the processing of Sensitive Data, as defined by California Privacy Law;  \u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003eOpt-out of the \u0026ldquo;Sale\u0026rdquo; or \u0026ldquo;sharing\u0026rdquo; of your CA Personal Data, as such terms are defined under California Privacy Law; and\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003eNot be discriminated against for exercising any of the above rights.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eAuthorized Agent.\u003c/strong\u003e You can designate an authorized agent to make a request under California law on your behalf in certain circumstances. If you use an authorized agent for this purpose, we may ask you to verify your identity or that you provided the authorized agent signed permission to submit a request on your behalf. If you provide an authorized agent with power of attorney pursuant to Probate Code sections 4000 to 4465, it may not be necessary to perform these steps, and we will respond to any request from such authorized agent in accordance with California law.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eNotice of Financial Incentive.\u003c/strong\u003e To the extent Agoda engages in financial incentives in connection with sweepstakes, loyalty programs, competitions, or other activities, we will provide information describing the material terms of the program and will obtain opt-in consent from users before they participate.  Users can opt-out from a program at any time by following the instructions provided in such terms.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eRight to Appeal Your Rights Requests.\u003c/strong\u003e You have the right to appeal our refusal to take action on your request. To exercise this right, you may submit your appeal in writing by contacting \u003ca href=\u0022mailto:privacy@agoda.com\u0022\u003eprivacy@agoda.com.\u003c/a\u003e If your request to exercise your data subject rights is rejected, you will receive a notification with the details of reason for rejection and instructions about how to make an appeal. We will respond to you within 45 days of your appeal submission. If your appeal is denied, you may contact the Attorney General of California.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eTo protect your privacy and security, we will verify your identity before responding to such request and may request you to provide us with information matching the identifiers and commercial information already maintained by Agoda about you or additional proof where necessary. If you are making this request on behalf of someone else, we may request the authorized agent provide us with a copy of a valid power of attorney or evidence of the written authorization. You will not be penalized for exercising your rights.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e\u003cu\u003eTürkiye\u003c/u\u003e\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIf you are a Turkish resident, the processing of your personal data will be subject to Law No. 6698 on Protection of Personal Data of Turkey (\u0026ldquo;Turkish Data Protection Law\u0026rdquo;). prevail.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eYour rights: According to Article 11 of the Turkish Data Protection Law, you have the following rights with respect to your personal data:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003ethe right to learn whether we process your personal data\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003ethe right to request information with regard to such processing, if we process your personal data\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003ethe right to learn the purposes of the processing and whether they are used for such purpose or not\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003ethe right to know the third parties within or outside the country, to whom we transfer your personal data\u003c/li\u003e\n\t\u003cli\u003ethe right to request cookies.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eMarketing Communications:\u003c/strong\u003e Under E-Commerce Law No. 6563 and secondary legislation, as a service provider, we rely on your explicit consent (opt-in consent) when sending marketing communications to you.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eInternational Data Transfers\u003c/strong\u003e: In the event that we where and if necessary.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e\u003cu\u003eJapan\u003c/u\u003e\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eUnder Japanese privacy law, you may have the right to request further information about our personal data processing, for example, requesting further information about our security control measures, the procedures for exercising your privacy rights and our representative details.
